entries.source_title: Counterexamples to the Monotone Completeness Conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: Combining a modification of the recent counterexample to the quasitrace conjecture with model-theoretic reductions due to the first author, we exhibit a counterexample to the monotone completeness conjecture. We fully reproduce the disproof of the quasitrace conjecture by a modified construction and arguments.

entries.source_title: Trace Inverse Estimates and Kernel-based Nitsche Galerkin Methods for Elliptic Interface Problems
entries.source_excerpt: We establish trace inverse estimates for products of independently generated Sobolev-kernel trial spaces on Lipschitz subdomains and use them to analyze symmetric Nitsche Galerkin methods for elliptic interface problems. The estimates control one-sided gradient traces by subdomain gradients, the interface jump, and an exterior boundary trace. Their conormal form provides the flux control required by the Nitsche formulation without imposing value constraints on the trial spaces, including configurations with an interior inclusion. For quasi-uniform center families with comparable fill distances and a fixed kernel scale, we obtain coercivity and well-posedness for sufficiently large penalty parameters independent of refinement. We prove energy and $L^2$ error bounds of orders $h^{s-1}$ and $h^s$ for piecewise $H^s$ solutions, $2\le s\le m$, where $h$ is the maximum fill distance and $m$ is the kernel Sobolev order. The $L^2$ bound additionally requires piecewise $H^2$ regularity of the homogeneous adjoint interface problem. For scaled kernels $\Phi_{m,\varepsilon}$ with $0<\varepsilon\le1$, we also derive a scale-explicit condition-numb

entries.source_title: Quantum Variance for Hecke--Maass Cusp Forms on the Vertical Geodesic
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X=\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb Z)\backslash\mathbb H$, and let $\{u_j\}$ be an orthonormal basis of even Hecke--Maass cusp forms on $X$ with Laplace eigenvalues $1/4+t_j^2$. For a real-valued $\psi\in C_c^\infty(0,\infty)$, define \[ \mu_j(\psi)=\int_0^\infty\psi(y)|u_j(iy)|^2\,\frac{dy}{y}, \qquad M(\psi)=\frac6\pi\int_0^\infty\psi(y)\,\frac{dy}{y}. \] For $T\ge2$, $1\le U\le T$, and every $\varepsilon>0$, we prove \[ \sum_{\substack{u_j\ {\rm even}\\T<\theta\le1$, $0<\eta<\theta/2$, and every $\varepsilon>0$, if $T^\theta\le U\le T$, then all but \[ O_{\psi,\theta,\eta,\varepsilon} \!\left(T^{1+2\eta+\varepsilon}\right) \] of the even forms with $T<t_j\le T+U$ satisfy $\mu_j(\psi)=M(\psi)+O(T^{-\eta})$. In particular, the exceptional proportion tends to zero in this short spectral interval.

entries.source_title: Model completeness for the differential field of transseries with exponentiation
entries.source_excerpt: We show that the expansion of the valued differential field of logarithmic-exponential transseries by its natural exponential function is model complete. We give an axiomatization of the theory of this expansion that is effective relative to the theory of the real exponential field, and show that any maximal Hardy field satisfies the same axioms. We use this to prove a transfer theorem between Hardy fields and transseries.

entries.source_title: ExpEvolve: Structuring and Reusing Experience for Open-Ended Discovery
entries.source_excerpt: Evolutionary coding agents such as AlphaEvolve are one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite their success, mutations over programs are mostly low-level upon surface heuristics, without a persistent unit of control. In contrast, science compounds through ideas. In this work, we propose ExpEvolve, which injects idea-level extraction and control into evolution: it discovers and leverages the high-level factors from programs that explain scoring differences among different programs. We characterize theoretical conditions on when discovery with idea factors improves sample efficiency. We also build a practical framework to show that the extracted high-level idea factors are helpful for guiding exploitation from experience and exploration when discovery comes to a plateau. entries.source_title: Optimal dimension growth rates in the high dimensional Central Limit Theorems
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the optimal dimension growth rates for the high-dimensional Central Limit Theorem (CLT) over half spaces, Euclidean balls and Borel convex sets, under the existence of fourth moments. It has been observed in the literature that $d=o(n^c)$ with $0< c\leq 1/2$ is sufficient for the CLT to hold over Euclidean balls. As a consequence, the CLT over half spaces should ideally hold under similar dimension growth rates. In case of Borel convex sets, however $d= o(n^{c})$ with $0< c\leq 2/5$ is generally sufficient. The most recent results for CLT over Euclidean balls and Borel convex sets with respective rates $d= o(\sqrt{n})$ and $d= o(n^{2/5})$ is due to Fang and Koike (2024) and under the existence of fourth moments. In this paper, we investigate whether these sufficient growth rates of $d$ with respect to $n$ are also necessary. Thus, our results completely characterize the sharpness of dimension growth rates under existence of fourth moments across half-spaces, Euclidean balls, and Borel convex sets.

entries.summary_zh: 这是一个公开清单，收录其维护者认为在开发、审查补丁或官方功能中使用了生成式 AI 的软件，并计划为反感生成式 AI 的用户提供项目选择参考。仓库也提出了关于开源软件伦理与社区治理的倡议；其纳入标准和相关判断属于该项目的立场与编辑规则。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究开源社区如何讨论生成式 AI 使用、维护者披露和治理分歧；阅读时可对照其纳入标准及每个项目的证据，避免把清单判断当成独立审计结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可按其清单了解项目的生成式 AI 使用争议，但摘录未展示具体条目或证据字段，直接用于选型的信息有限。

entries.paper_review: README 列出纳入和移除标准，并称旧仓库记录保存在 legacy 分支，但摘录未提供逐项目的证据审查材料。

project_insight.translation_zh: 该仓库是一个公开清单，收录在开发或审查补丁过程中使用了超过少量 LLM 的软件。其短期目标是帮助反感生成式 AI 的用户识别可能希望避开的项目，并推动相关项目说明立场；长期目标是为开源软件伦理议题提供讨论和解决冲突的框架。收录条件包括开发者当前在开发或补丁审查中使用 LLM，或官方项目集成生成式 AI；移除条件包括项目建立不使用 LLM 或生成式 AI 参与开发及审查的政策，或有意移除相关功能。仓库以 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可发布，并禁止围攻和骚扰。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 按维护者设定的标准整理生成式 AI 影响软件的公开清单，并倡议围绕开源社区伦理进行讨论。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先读清单的纳入、移除与反骚扰规则，再查看具体条目及所链接的项目资料；将清单视为立场鲜明的整理来源，并在作出项目选择前核对原始证据。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是带有明确反生成式 AI 立场的清单与倡议，不是中立认证或独立审计。摘录没有具体条目及其证明材料；仓库许可为 CC BY-SA 4.0，维护者明确禁止围攻、骚扰等行为。
use_cases_zh: 查看某个开源项目是否被该清单收录，再回到原项目核对其政策与证据。
研究开源社区对 AI 辅助开发、披露和治理规则的不同立场。

entries.source_title: Exact Realization of Edge and Induced Three-Vertex Subgraph Counts
entries.source_excerpt: The study of three-vertex subgraph densities has developed along two complementary lines: exact finite realization in large graphs of a given order, and asymptotic approximate realization by sequences of graphs. We bridge these viewpoints for the edge density and the four induced three-vertex subgraph densities. By analyzing local modifications of finite samples from graphons, we show that, for any nonempty subset of these densities, every asymptotically feasible target vector lying a fixed positive distance from the boundary of the corresponding feasible region is realized exactly by a graph of every sufficiently large order, subject only to the natural arithmetic constraints. Thus, in the interior of these feasible regions, asymptotic feasibility implies exact finite realizability up to the unavoidable arithmetic obstructions.

entries.title_zh: FineEnvs/openai-math：用于 Harbor 的 Lean 数学证明环境数据集
entries.summary_zh: 该数据集把 OpenAI 的 openai/math 数学问题移植为 Harbor 环境，369 个任务的官方证明已在所述环境中由 oracle 端到端验证；原发布中的 405 条 Lean 陈述有 36 条未纳入，原因包括依赖缺失、内存不足或验证未完成。任务要求智能体在 Lean 4 与预构建 Mathlib 沙箱中补全证明，并由独立沙箱中的 Lean 内核检查精确陈述。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对研究 Lean 定理证明智能体、基准构造或奖励判定的人有直接价值，尤其值得关注其严格验证规则和未纳入任务的记录；运行成本和判分限制也应纳入实验设计。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于 Harbor 智能体的定理证明实验，但每个任务需要较多计算资源，且需配置 Daytona 与模型凭据。
entries.cynic_review: 严格匹配原陈述让判分更明确，却会把等价表述、部分进展和有缺口的策略一律记为零，限制了它作为开放式数学研究信号的代表性。
entries.paper_review: 材料给出任务数、验证规则、官方证明的 oracle 结果及失败分类，证据较具体，但本摘录仍不是对数据集或其证明的独立复核。

project_insight.translation_zh: 这是将 OpenAI 发布的 openai/math 问题移植为 Harbor 环境的数据集。发布说明称，原发布将 405 个结果形式化为 Lean 陈述；本数据集包含其中 369 个环境，其官方证明已在相应环境中端到端验证，覆盖 17 个领域的 214 个结果族。任务要求智能体在无网络的 Lean 4 与预构建 Mathlib 沙箱中补全缺失证明，随后由新的沙箱检查证明是否对应完全相同的原陈述、没有遗留 sorry 或新增公理，并被 Lean 内核接受。项目标注 Apache-2.0，并另列 openai/math 的许可与归属文件。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一组用于 Harbor 的 Lean 4 定理证明任务，以精确陈述匹配和 Lean 内核检查作为成功判据。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读数据集的 Validation 与严格奖励说明，挑选少量任务确认 Lean 陈述、依赖和 oracle 状态；按页面要求准备 Harbor 0.24+、Daytona 后端及智能体凭据，并预留约 9 GB 的共享沙箱镜像构建资源和每题所列资源。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 页面明确标注该数据集为实验性，底层研究发布也尚未独立审阅，并建议依赖评分为 1 的证明前先阅读证明。369 个任务之外还有 36 条陈述未验证；任务需 Daytona、智能体凭据、每题 4 CPU/8 GB 内存/10 GB 磁盘且最长 4 小时，页面报告已接受证明的中位验证耗时为 8 分钟。判分要求完全证明原始精确陈述，不奖励等价改写或部分进展。
use_cases_zh: 比较不同代码智能体或模型完成 Lean 4 数学证明任务的能力。
研究形式化证明基准如何设计可复核的奖励与防作弊验证。
用已验证任务测试 Lean 工具链、Mathlib 环境或智能体解题流程。

entries.source_title: On the Proportion of Time that a Conventional Confidence Interval Covers
entries.source_excerpt: The concept of confidence sequences, or `anytime confidence intervals,' has attracted significant interest in recent years. This motivates the question of how well conventional confidence intervals behave when similarly evaluated. In particular, we study the probability distribution of the proportion of time a conventional confidence interval procedure covers the population mean, when the total time $n$ spent sampling is large. We establish an invariance principle for the limiting distribution as $n$ tends to infinity and show that the limit random variable $Z(1)$ can be expressed as a functional of Brownian motion. The random variable $Z(1)$ exhibits a scale invariance property that enables the derivation of a partial differential equation (PDE) for the density of $Z(1)$ jointly with the Brownian motion at $t=1$, namely $B(1)$. We show that this density can also be computed as the stationary distribution of a two-dimensional singular diffusion, one component of which is an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. entries.title_zh: 传统置信区间覆盖总体均值的时间比例

entries.source_title: Training Mixed-Monotone Neural Networks for Verification Without Set Propagation
entries.source_excerpt: Most formal verification approaches for neural networks conservatively enclose the output set of the neural network. However, computing a tight output enclosure is in general computationally hard. We sidestep this challenge with a novel neural network architecture that realizes mixed-monotone functions as the difference of monotone subnetworks. By utilizing the theory on mixed-monotone systems, this reduces the computation of a tight output enclosure from complicated set propagation to two simple forward passes of opposite corners of an input interval. Moreover, because the size of the resulting enclosure is a closed-form function of the weights of the neural network, we can directly minimize it during training. We prove a lower bound on the size of any such enclosure, given by the total variation of the represented function generalized to several inputs, which makes it possible to compare the tightness of the enclosure against the optimum. Our evaluation on regression and dynamical-system benchmarks demonstrates that our training reduces the enclosure size to within 0.5% of the lower bound without sacrificing prediction accuracy. Com

entries.source_title: Optimal Multitask Representations Under a Rate Constraint: An Information Bottleneck Analysis
entries.source_excerpt: Which pretraining objective yields the best representation for downstream tasks under an information budget? We formalize this problem as a multitask information bottleneck, using a mutual information constraint to model incomplete information retention. For Gaussian inputs and tasks, we characterize optimal representations and show that a weakly task-aligned specialist can outperform a reconstruction generalist at low rates but lose at high rates. We also construct task families for which every fixed Gaussian prediction objective incurs arbitrarily large relative regret, driven by reversals in optimal allocation priorities. Conversely, the average task information matrix defines an objective with a uniform relative-regret bound controlled by maximum task SNR. CelebA and dSprites experiments illustrate that compression can change which pretraining objective performs best, and even task-aware training can reverse which downstream task is better preserved as rate increases.

entries.source_title: Use LLMs to check your work
entries.source_excerpt: Most discussions about LLMs in mathematics seem to focus on their (rapidly advancing) proof discovery abilities and the effects these abilities may have on professional mathematics. I write here about a different use of these technologies, to make the following point: we have a professional duty to use LLMs to proofread our work.

entries.source_title: DELA: Learning Controllable Edits for Diffusion Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support bidirectional denoising and iterative refinement, but generation remains largely controlled by token-level masking schedules. This leaves draft-level refinement implicit and limits explicit control over when to insert missing content, delete redundant spans, revisit uncertain regions, or stop editing. We introduce Diffusion Editing Language Adapter (DELA), a plug-in framework that enables controllable draft refinement with a frozen DLM. DELA operates on clean, variable-length drafts using four explicit editing actions: Insert, Delete, Remask, and Stop. The controller determines when and where to edit the draft, while the frozen DLM fills masked regions through denoising, separating high-level edit control from token-level generation. A naive single-phase editor would be computationally expensive because arbitrary interior edits can disrupt prefix stability and limit reliable KV-cache reuse. entries.title_zh: DELA：为扩散语言模型学习可控编辑

entries.source_title: On the stability of second-order methods for DDEs and PDDEs
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, a one-parameter family of second-order implicit--explicit (IMEX) multistep methods is studied for delay differential equations (DDEs). The analysis is based on the matrix problem $y'(t)=A y(t) + B y(t-\tau(t))$, where $A$ is Hermitian negative definite but $B$ is any matrix. For constant, grid-aligned delays, a field-of-values argument yields unconditional stability whenever a suitable generalized field of values $F_p(A,B)$ is contained in the open unit disk. For a constant non-grid-aligned delay, we show that quadratic interpolation does not reduce the corresponding stability disk. For genuinely variable delays, the method is formulated as a nonautonomous augmented system, and product-level sufficient conditions are obtained from a common quadratic Lyapunov inequality and from a quantitative slow-variation hypothesis. The approach developed herein is illustrated through several examples in which the discussed theory is applied not only to DDEs, but also to semidiscrete parabolic problems given by partial delay differential equations with a diffusion term.
entries.title_zh: 时滞微分方程二阶方法的稳定性

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合时滞系统和半离散抛物方程的数值稳定分析。

entries.source_title: Schnorr Randomness and Effective Bayesian Consistency and Inconsistency
entries.source_excerpt: We study Doob's Consistency Theorem and Freedman's Inconsistency Theorem from the vantage point of computable probability and algorithmic randomness. We show that the Schnorr random elements of the parameter space are computably consistent, when there is a map from the sample space to the parameter space satisfying many of the same properties as limiting relative frequencies. We show that the generic inconsistency in Freedman's Theorem is effectively comeager, which implies the existence of computable parameters which are not computably consistent. Taken together, this work provides a computability-theoretic solution to Diaconis and Freedman's problem of ``know[ing] for which [parameters] the rule [Bayes' rule] is consistent'', and it strengthens recent similar results of Takahashi on Martin-L\"of randomness in Cantor space.
entries.title_zh: Schnorr 随机性与有效贝叶斯一致/不一致

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算法随机性、统计学基础及可计算贝叶斯推断研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把随机性等级与贝叶斯一致性条件联系起来，并给出存在性结论。

entries.source_title: Derived categories of threefolds near the Noether line
entries.source_excerpt: We show that derived categories of canonical stacks associated to general threefolds in the principal component of the moduli space of canonical threefolds on the refined Noether line are semiorthogonally indecomposable. First we generalize a criterion of Kawatani-Okawa for the indecomposability of derived categories of surfaces of general type to higher-dimensional varieties and stacks. And then we generalize a construction of Kobayashi and Hu-Zhang and a classification result of Coughlan-Pignatelli to the second and third Noether lines to show that our criterion applies to these canonical stacks.
entries.title_zh: Noether 线附近三维簇的导出范畴
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，位于 canonical threefold 模空间主分支 refined Noether line 附近的一般三维簇，其典范 stack 的导出范畴不能作非平凡半正交分解。证明先把 Kawatani–Okawa 的不可分解判据推广到高维簇与 stack，再将已有构造和分类推广到第二、第三 Noether 线以满足判据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对典范三维簇的导出范畴结构给出不可分解结论，并扩展了曲面判据。
entries.pragmatic_review: 属高阶代数几何结构结果，应用范围专业。

entries.source_title: The dual complex and RC-invariant functors
entries.source_excerpt: We extend the dual complex of a simple normal crossings divisor to a homotopy type invariant $\mathcal{D}(X)$ of arbitrary complex varieties, and we prove that it is contractible when $X$ is connected and of klt type. In fact, the dual complex belongs to a broader class of invariants, which we call RC (rationally connected)-invariant functors. We prove a rigidity theorem governing the behavior of such functors with respect to rationally connected fibrations.

entries.source_title: Understanding the Benefits of Scaffolds through Computational Separations
entries.source_excerpt: Inference-time harnesses, i.e., external procedures that call a model many times and keep state across calls, can substantially improve model capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the benefits of using such harnesses and the extent to which these benefits can be internalized through training. More precisely, we conceptualize a harness $\mathcal{A}$ as an arbitrary wrapper around a base model $M$ and attempt to distill a student model from the harness's traces. Empirically we find that, even with simple scaffolds and small models, the inference-time harness significantly outperforms a distilled student. We then prove that such a gap is due to a fundamental representational limitation: inference-time harnesses can compute a closure of their per-call primitive that is $\NL$-complete even when the primitive is a trivial $\AC^0$ lookup, and that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under the widely believed conjecture that $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$. entries.title_zh: 通过计算分离理解推理脚手架的收益
entries.summary_zh: 推理时脚手架是能多次调用模型并跨调用保留状态的外部程序，常可显著提升任务能力；论文研究这些收益能否通过训练蒸馏进单个学生模型。作者将脚手架视作任意模型包装器，实验发现即使简单脚手架和小模型也能胜过蒸馏学生，并用计算分离证明某些脚手架可计算的函数闭包具有基础模型单次调用无法表达的能力。

entries.source_title: Order-Specified Quaternion CP Decomposition: Models, Algorithms, and Applications
entries.source_excerpt: Tensor CP decomposition serves as a fundamental tool for representing multiway data. While quaternion tensors are well suited to modeling color visual data, extending CP decomposition to the quaternion domain is nontrivial due to the noncommutativity of quaternion multiplication. This paper develops an order-specified quaternion CP decomposition (OS-QCP) for third-order tensors, allowing all three factor matrices to be quaternion-valued and explicitly incorporating their multiplication order into the model. We show that different multiplication orders can yield different OS-QCP ranks for the same quaternion tensor, characterize the permutation and quaternion scaling indeterminacies, and establish a sufficient condition for essential uniqueness for any prescribed multiplication order. An explicit example further shows that OS-QCP rank can depend on the multiplication order even when the complex representation of the quaternion tensor admits an essentially unique CP decomposition. An alternating least-squares (ALS) algorithm is derived by expressing quaternion left and right multiplication as real linear operators, reducing each factor
entries.title_zh: 指定乘法顺序的四元数 CP 张量分解
entries.summary_zh: 论文为三阶四元数张量构造指定乘法顺序的 CP 分解，因为四元数乘法不交换，因子相乘顺序会改变模型与秩。作者刻画置换及四元数缩放不确定性，给出本质唯一性的充分条件，并展示即使复表示有本质唯一分解，四元数秩仍可能依赖乘法顺序；算法方面把左右四元数乘法改写为实线性算子，用交替最小二乘求解，另提出加权融合不同顺序的张量补全模型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 明确处理非交换乘法导致的秩与唯一性问题，并给出可计算分解及补全方案。

entries.source_title: Logic vs doctrines, a mirror symmetry
entries.source_excerpt: This paper studies doctrines in categorical logic and their relations to fragments of geometric logic. After a brief account of the historical context for the notion of doctrine in categorical logic, we propose our working definition. We then show that there is a Galois connection between the poset of doctrines and the poset of fragments of geometric logic as defined in the framework of Kan injectivity in the 2-category of topoi, recently developed by the first and third authors. Concretely, the connection is realised by a general construction of syntactic categories and classifying topoi which encompasses all well-known examples in categorical logic. This yields a mirror symmetry, between the algebraic world of doctrines and the geometric world of topoi: to provide evidence of this phenomenon, we prove a few symmetric results relating doctrines and logics by means of syntactic categories and classifying topoi. We conclude with a discussion on the theme of conceptual completeness.
entries.title_zh: 逻辑与 doctrines 的镜像关系

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 为 doctrine 与几何逻辑之间的对应提供统一的 Galois 连接和成对构造视角。

entries.source_title: Are Linguistic and Arithmetic Circuits Dissociated in LLMs?
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit both knowledge of language, rendered by, for example, grammatical judgment ability, and abilities to perform tasks through language, such as math-word problem solving. Motivated by neurolinguistic studies of their neural dissociation in human brains, in this study, we investigate the overlap of their circuits in large language models (LLMs). Specifically, we examine the overlap and causal effects between the circuits extracted for linguistic and arithmetic tasks, using controlled materials and circuit discovery methods from the mechanistic interpretability field. Our experiments with five LLMs show that circuit similarity is mostly explained by task domains (linguistic vs. arithmetic), rather than by their input and output vocabularies or by the syntactic similarities between natural-language sentences and arithmetic expressions. This finding suggests that LLMs may process linguistic and arithmetic information using largely separate neural circuits, highlighting an ability-based modular organization of circuits within these models.
entries.title_zh: 大语言模型中的语言与算术电路是否分离？

entries.source_title: The transition between order to disorder in the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model of first-passage percolation along a region of the plane where it moves from an ordered to a disordered phase, represented by a 2nd order discontinuity in its limit shape function. The fluctuations in this transition region are of order one, and we determine that certain limiting statistics are described by Fredholm determinants and are closely related to the largest eigenvalue of the GUE.

entries.source_title: An upper bound on the smallest singular value of dense signed random combinatorial matrices
entries.source_excerpt: Let $M_n$ be an $n\times n$ random matrix with entries in $\{-1, 0, 1\}$, where each row is independently and uniformly sampled from the set of all vectors in $\{-1, 0, 1\}^n$ containing exactly $d$ nonzero entries, with $d=pn$ for some fixed constant $p\in(0,1/2]$. A recent result by one of the authors gives a lower bound of order $n^{-1/2}$ for the smallest singular value $s_n(M_n)$ of this model with high probability. In this paper, we establish a matching upper bound for $s_n(M_n)$. Specifically, there exists a constant $C_p>0$ depending only on $p$ such that \[ \forall \varepsilon >0 \qquad \mathbb{P} \left( s_n(M_n) \le \frac{\sqrt{d}}{\varepsilon^2 n} \right) \ge 1-C_p\left(\varepsilon + \frac{1}{\sqrt{d}}\right). \] Consequently, in the dense regime, the smallest singular value $s_n(M_n)$ of signed random combinatorial matrices is typically of order $n^{-1/2}$.

entries.source_title: Skew-Symmetric Formulations and Energy-Stable Schemes for Compressible Reactive Flow Equations
entries.source_excerpt: This paper develops skew-symmetric formulations and energy stable finite difference schemes for the reactive Euler and reactive Navier--Stokes equations. By introducing suitable transformed variables, we rewrite the governing equations into skew-symmetric forms and obtain continuous energy estimates by standard integration-by-parts arguments. The proposed formulations extend the skew-symmetric framework for compressible flow equations to reactive systems, where the chemical energy and the species equation must be incorporated into the transformed variables. Based on these formulations, we construct semi-discrete schemes with summation-by-parts (SBP) operators. The convective terms are discretized by the non-dissipative part of linear upwind SBP operators, while a nonlinear SBP--WENO operator is used only to supply artificial dissipation near discontinuities. For periodic boundary conditions, the resulting schemes satisfy semi-discrete energy estimates consistent with the continuous analysis. entries.title_zh: 可压缩反应流方程的斜对称形式与能量稳定格式

entries.source_title: Algorithmic drift in generative adaptive learning
entries.source_excerpt: Generative artificial intelligence promises to democratize personalized tutoring, yet the longitudinal stability of adaptive systems remains under-theorized. Current ethical discourse focuses on static bias. This paper argues that a distinct threat lies in algorithmic drift: a feedback loop in which minor, demographically asymmetric observation errors compound over time into systemic inequities. We make three contributions. First, we formalize algorithmic drift as a coupled learner--tutor dynamical system. Second, we corroborate this theory with an agent-based Monte Carlo simulation in which either a transparent online tracker or an LSTM deep-knowledge-tracing network drives an IRT-based curriculum policy. Third, we introduce the temporal fairness stabilizer (TFS), a targeted intervention that periodically re-probes learner capability, and benchmark it against standard exploration baselines with explicit group-fairness metrics and replication-level inference. entries.source_title: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural-network training
entries.source_excerpt: Dynamical coarse-graining of neural networks gives macroscopic observables and enables training to be predicted, and controlled in a state space far smaller than the parameter space. In this paper, we first define the learning operator following the training law of neural networks and establish a descent theorem for the learning operator, which serves to determine whether the operator is sufficient to characterize the learning dynamics. Then the exact closure theorem and the dynamic coarse-graining theorem are presented in sequence. The three theorems established in this paper provide a systematic framework for constructing and assessing dynamical coarse-grained models of neural-network training. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of the theorems with a finite-width nonlinear ReLU network. Its dynamic coarse-grained model for a fixed pattern is exactly derived and composed of five independent moments. The model exactly predict the training outputs and evolving learning operator. The framework may also guide the development of approximate coarse-grained models for more general neural networks when exact closure is unavailable.

entries.source_title: Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. entries.title_zh: 自适应回拉：按惩罚跃升重加权在线蒸馏监督

entries.source_title: The Batch Size Can Be One: Test-Time Adaptation from Classifier Geometry
entries.source_excerpt: Test-time adaptation updates a deployed model on an unlabeled test stream. In practice this stream often arrives one sample at a time, with the classes in no particular order. A single sample then provides limited information for estimating distribution-level statistics, and selecting samples by confidence can admit predictions that are wrong yet confident. A corruption, however, shifts the features while leaving the decision regions of the frozen classifier unchanged. We therefore propose Origin-recentered Test-Time Adaptation (OriTTA), which constructs fixed geometric targets from the source model and adapts selected features toward them. Seen from the origin of the feature space, the classes lean toward a common direction. We choose a new origin to bring class scores closer together while keeping it near the mean feature of one synthetic prototype per class. From this origin, prototype directions spread more evenly, and each class obtains an axis and an ideal point before any test data arrives. entries.source_title: Sample, Mix, or Verify? Allocating Test-Time Compute under Imperfect Verifiers
entries.source_excerpt: A common way to make language models and agents more accurate is to spend more compute at inference time: generate many candidate solutions and submit the one a verifier prefers. Success then requires that some candidate is correct and that the verifier picks it. The first grows predictably with the number of samples; the second does not, because real verifiers (unit tests, majority votes, LLM judges, reward models) accept wrong answers, reject right ones, and make correlated mistakes. With a fixed budget, a practitioner must decide how many samples to draw, which models to draw them from, and how much to spend on verification, and today these choices are made by rules of thumb. We introduce SPLIT, which makes them from a small labelled pilot. It rests on an exact formula for the probability of submitting a correct answer under accept/reject and top-score selection that accounts for varying task difficulty, blind spots shared across models, and correlated repeated verifier calls. SPLIT fits the formula by empirical Bayes and uses it to plan budgets on unseen tasks. Across seven benchmarks spanning math, science QA, code and software-e

entries.source_title: Density Bounds in Hua's Theorem for Prime Squares
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a density version of Hua's theorem in the five-variable case: if $\mathcal P$ is a subset of the primes with relative lower density greater than $0.82$, then every sufficiently large $n\equiv5\pmod{24}$ is a sum of five squares of primes from $\mathcal P$.

entries.source_title: Ask to Distill: Learning to Synthesize Data for On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) can succeed with surprisingly few training questions, motivating a view of questions as carriers of distributional knowledge transfer. How can we assess whether a newly generated question is valuable for distillation, and learn to generate better questions---without access to its correct answer? We introduce Ask-to-Distill (\method), a framework that treats synthetic questions as distribution elicitors and optimizes the teacher supervision they expose along student-generated trajectories. A student-initialized synthesizer is optimized using a distributional surrogate for question value, computed from a frozen student--teacher pair without reference answers, correctness rewards, or per-candidate student updates. The reward combines teacher--student disagreement with teacher probability mass on the student's candidate support, together with length and diversity controls. The generated questions are filtered and deduplicated into a prompt-only bank for standard OPD. entries.source_title: Inverse problems with fractional operators: an analytical study and its numerical linear algebra treatment via the GLT theory
entries.source_excerpt: Fractional derivatives model memory effects and nonlocal interactions beyond classical integer-order models. Fractional differential equations (FDEs) thus describe anomalous diffusion, transport in heterogeneous media, and hereditary dynamics. Their nonlocality, however, makes inverse problems challenging: unknown sources, coefficients, or initial conditions must be recovered from indirect and noisy data. Inverse problems for FDEs are usually ill-posed in the Hadamard sense, so regularization, such as the quasi-boundary value method, is required for stable reconstruction. Discretization produces large linear systems whose matrices inherit the nonlocal structure of fractional operators. Understanding the asymptotic spectral properties of these matrix sequences is essential for efficient solvers and preconditioners. Generalized Locally Toeplitz (GLT) theory provides a unified framework for the spectral distribution of large structured matrices and for preconditioner design. This thesis uses GLT theory to analyze matrix sequences from inverse problems for FDEs, construct structure-preserving preconditioners, and study nonlinear operation

entries.source_title: AI Teaches Humans to Handle Complexity in the Game of Go
entries.source_excerpt: Strategic decision-making in complex environments requires balancing local stability against global coordination. Using the game of Go as a bounded empirical testbed, we investigate how biological and artificial agents navigate this trade-off by formalizing a network-derived metric of strategic tension defined via the spectral radius of spatial dependency matrices. Across human skill progression, tension systematically decays from novices to masters as uncoordinated tactical skirmishes give way to disciplined territorial stabilization. However, a longitudinal analysis of professional play spanning 1980--2026 reveals a striking historical paradox: following the superhuman breakthrough of AlphaGo in 2016, elite human matches display a marked surge in sustained tension. A two-dimensional projection based on move distance and captures places modern professionals close to neural engines, separating their tension from the local contact fighting of novices and from random noise. entries.source_title: Beyond Data Schedule: Fast LLM Pretraining on Data Mixtures by Loss-Reweighting
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mixture or requiring additional runs to search for weights. entries.source_title: Asymptotical results on the automorphism groups of canonical double cover of graphs
entries.source_excerpt: The canonical double cover $BX$ of a graph $X$ is the direct product $X\times K_2$. A graph $X$ is stable if every automorphism of $BX$ is induced by automorphisms of $X$ and $K_2$, and unstable otherwise. We prove several asymptotic results on stable and unstable graphs. In particular, we show that the automorphism group of the canonical double cover of almost every graph has order $2$, and consequently that almost all graphs are stable. We also prove that the dominant sources of instability are having twins and being disconnected, in that order, and that graphs arising from a known construction are the next step in this hierarchy.

entries.source_excerpt: Frontier AI models are increasingly deployed on topics where the stakes are high and expert judgment is required, including healthcare, defense, finance, governance, and politics. entries.source_title: Galois Groups of Shifted Exponential Polynomials
entries.source_excerpt: Consider the shifted truncations of the exponential series and their Galois groups: $$F_{n,a}(x) := \sum_{j=0}^{n}\frac{x^j}{(a+j)!}\qquad G_{n,a}:= \text{Gal}(F_{n,a}/\mathbb{Q}).$$ In this paper we prove that for every fixed integer $a>0$, the set of $n$ for which $G_{n,a}=S_n$ has natural density one, thus answering a question of Katz and Rivin.
entries.title_zh: 平移截断指数多项式的伽罗瓦群
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究函数 F_(n,a)(x)=Σ_(j=0)^n x^j/(a+j)! 的伽罗瓦群 G_(n,a)，证明对每个固定正整数 a，使 G_(n,a) 等于对称群 S_n 的 n 构成自然密度为 1 的集合。该结果回答 Katz 与 Rivin 提出的相关问题，说明当次数 n 增大时，几乎所有这类多项式具有最大对称群。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出一族带阶乘系数多项式伽罗瓦群几乎总为最大对称群的密度定理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 主要面向数论与伽罗瓦群研究，结论可作为该多项式族的典型性结果。
entries.cynic_review: 密度一不意味着每个 n 都成立，少数例外仍可能存在。
entries.paper_review: 以自然密度精确回答既有问题，主结论简洁清楚。

entries.source_title: Vertex Removal and Vertex-Edge Domination
entries.source_excerpt: A vertex $v$ of a graph $G$ $ve$-dominates every edge incident with a vertex in its closed neighborhood $N_{G}[v]$. A set of vertices is a vertex-edge dominating set ($ve$-dominating set) if every edge of $G$ is $ve$-dominated by some vertex in the set. The minimum cardinality of such a set is the vertex-edge domination number $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, also known as the isolation number. In this paper, we study the effect of vertex removal on $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, establish sharp bounds on $\gamma_{ve}(G-v)$ and characterize the vertices whose removal decreases, preserves, or increases $\gamma_{ve}(G)$. Let $V^0(G)$ and $V^+(G)$ denote the sets of vertices whose removal preserves and increases $\gamma_{ve}(G)$, respectively, and let $V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)$ consist of the vertices in $V^0(G)$ belonging to every minimum $ve$-dominating set. We prove that \[ |V^0(G)|\geq3|V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)|+\sum_{v\in V^+(G)} \bigl(\gamma_{ve}(G-v)-\gamma_{ve}(G)+1\bigr). \] In particular, $|V^0(G)|\geq 2|V^+(G)|$. We also prove that every vertex in $V_{\mathrm{fix}}^0(G)$ lies on a cycle and that $V^0(T)\neq\emptyset$ for every tree $T$ of order at least three.

entries.source_title: Matrix-Free Local Multigrid for $C^1$ Hermite Discretizations on GPUs
entries.source_excerpt: I present a matrix-free local multigrid method for $C^1$ tensor-product Hermite discretizations on adaptively refined Cartesian meshes, using the clamped biharmonic problem as the model problem. Extending a cell-wise primal-dual formulation to Hermite elements, I enforce continuity through a constraint operator that is never formed. At refinement edges, geometric prolongation supplies both the trace and its normal derivative, so the local V-cycle needs no edge operator and no hanging-node machinery. For the cubic element, an even-odd decomposition based on the signed reflection symmetry of the Hermite basis, applied along two axes, splits the element matrix into four dense $16\times16$ blocks and reaches 85% of peak memory bandwidth. Chebyshev-Jacobi and vertex-patch smoothers both preserve conformity by construction. In three dimensions on one NVIDIA A100 in double precision, conjugate gradients preconditioned by the Chebyshev-Jacobi V-cycle need five or six iterations on uniform meshes and solve at up to 4.23 million cells per second. entries.source_title: Invariants of big classes from asymptotic total Betti numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce and study a new numerical invariant of big line bundles on normal complex projective varieties, defined in terms of the total Betti number of hypersurfaces associated with high tensor powers of the line bundle. We prove that this invariant is birational and provides an upper bound for the volume of the line bundle. When the big line bundle admits a rational Zariski decomposition, we show that the invariant coincides with the volume. In particular, this holds when the line bundle is ample or is defined on a projective surface. We also investigate the analogous problem in the real algebraic setting, proving the existence of real algebraic hypersurfaces associated with high tensor powers of a big line bundle whose real vanishing loci have arbitrarily large total Betti numbers.

entries.source_title: PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration
entries.source_excerpt: Many mathematical research agents focus on solving problems with fixed statements. However, conjecture research, especially in applied mathematics, may require revising candidate questions or conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development. We present PACE, a research-proof agent that supports this process through a structured research loop that selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms. The whole prover constructs proofs from these mechanisms, and an independent verifier checks them against the original target. Evidence-tracking memory stores assumptions and dependencies arising during research and marks evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. This memory supports task-specific context composition that keeps checked premises, exploratory material and unresolved obligations distinct. entries.source_title: The Logarithmic A-Discriminant
entries.source_excerpt: We extend the GKZ theory of discriminants to the setting of Euler integrals where both coefficients and exponents are variables. The integrand is the likelihood function of a toric model in algebraic statistics, whose number of critical points is the volume of the Newton polytope. Our logarithmic A-discriminant vanishes when two critical points come together. This discriminant is a hypersurface, parametrized by the logarithmic Horn uniformization. Hurwitz forms of toric varieties yield a degree formula, and a description of leading coefficients. We emphasize applications and computations.
entries.title_zh: 对数 A-判别式
entries.summary_zh: 作者把 GKZ 判别式理论推广到系数与指数都可变的 Euler 积分情形，其被积函数对应环面代数统计模型的似然函数。定义的对数 A-判别式在两个临界点合并时为零，并证明它是可由对数 Horn 参数化的超曲面；同时从 toric variety 的 Hurwitz 形式导出次数与首项系数描述。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把判别式、似然临界点和环面几何连接起来，适合代数统计与计算代数几何研究。

entries.source_title: Spectral asymmetry and odd cycles in integral graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the triangle $C_3$ is the only integral unicyclic graph with an odd cycle. The main tool is a spectral inequality that does not require integrality: if $G$ is a connected non-bipartite graph and $G-e$ is bipartite for some edge $e$, then the eigenvalues $\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_n$ of $G$ satisfy $\sum_{i}(\lambda_i+\lambda_{n+1-i})^+\le 2$ and $0<\lambda_1+\lambda_n\le 1$. It follows from comparing $A(G)$ with the signed adjacency matrix obtained by reversing the sign of $e$, which is similar to $-A(G)$, through a common rank-one perturbation and Weyl's monotonicity theorem. For integral graphs in this class, an arithmetic lemma then gives $\lambda_n=1-\lambda_1$ and at least $\lambda_1-1\ge1$ triangles, which yields the classification. We also prove that an integral graph of odd girth $g$ has at least $(g-1)!/2$ cycles of length $g$, with equality for the Petersen graph when $g=5$, and we derive consequences for quantum periodicity a

entries.source_title: Simultaneous popular polynomial differences in higher dimensions
entries.source_excerpt: We extend the simultaneous popular polynomial difference theorem of Conlon, Dong, and the author to polynomial shifts along prescribed directions in $\mathbb{F}_p^D$. Let $P_1,\ldots,P_k\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be linearly independent polynomials with zero constant terms, and let $v_1,\ldots,v_k\in\mathbb{Z}^D\setminus\{0\}$. We show that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, every sufficiently large prime $p$, and every $A\subseteq\mathbb{F}_p^D$ of density $\alpha$, there exists a nonzero $d\in\mathbb{F}_p$ such that \[ \mathbb{E}_{\underline{x}\in\mathbb{F}_p^D} \mathbf{1}_A(\underline{x}) \prod_{\substack{1\leq i\leq k\\ \omega_i=1}} \mathbf{1}_A\bigl(\underline{x}+P_i(d)v_i\bigr) \geq \alpha^{\,1+\sum_{i=1}^k\omega_i}-\varepsilon \] simultaneously for every $\omega\in\{0,1\}^k$. The main new ingredient is a directional arithmetic regularity decomposition adapted to mixed directional box norms.

entries.source_title: The Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) Method for Time Series Arising from Dynamical Systems
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems. CLOCK embeds observed sequences into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via a time-averaged occupation kernel, enabling trajectory comparison through their RKHS norm. For systems governed by differential equations, this formulation rigorously approximates the kernel mean embedding of the invariant Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen (SRB) measure, meaning our dissimilarity metric approximates the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between attractors. To accommodate general time series, we introduce time lags via Takens' Embedding Theorem to reconstruct the phase space. Crucially, CLOCK natively handles trajectories of unequal lengths and irregularly-spaced observations. We validate the proposed metric using spectral clustering, demonstrating superior performance against benchmark methods on both synthetic datasets and a real-world intracranial large-scale electroencephalogram (EEG) dataset. entries.source_title: EDMA: Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering
entries.source_excerpt: Multimodal question answering (MMQA) is based on integrating heterogeneous data sources, selectively leveraging relevant modalities, and ignoring distractors. Existing approaches based on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) improve performance by splitting the task into intermediate steps, but do not quantify how each modality contributes to reaching the final answer. We argue that quantifying the effect that each modality has on the answering process improves process traceability and final performance. Thus, we propose Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering (EDMA), which uses logical entropy to formalise multimodal QA as an iterative process of entropy reduction and to quantify the contribution of each modality in distinguishing correct from incorrect candidate answers. This enables the construction of quantifiable answering trajectories, where each step is associated with a measurable entropy reduction. entries.source_title: Inductive Grounded Arithmetic: Goodstein, the Hydra, and $\Gamma_0$
entries.source_excerpt: What does a recursive definition mean when the logic is grounded, so a sentence is true only if a terminating process makes it so? Kripke's answer for the special case of truth was the least fixed point. This paper takes that answer as a rule. Reflective Grounded Arithmetic (RGA) already writes any recursive definition as one self-referential term, paradoxes included. Inductive Grounded Arithmetic (IGA) adds the elimination rule for every positive one, so that accessibility, the winning positions of a game, and grounded truth itself each come with their own induction principle. The rule is sound for the omega model and the system is consistent, both machine-checked in Isabelle/HOL. With the rule, IGA proves Goodstein's theorem outright, in a logic without implication at an undecided hypothesis, and the Kirby-Paris hydra game for primitive recursive strategies, both with every step of the arithmetic a grounded derivation. entries.source_title: A vanishing-cycle obstruction to smoothing Calabi-Yau threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a homological obstruction to smoothing projective Calabi-Yau threefolds with nodes and anticanonical cones over smooth del Pezzo surfaces of degrees six and seven. On a crepant resolution that is small over the nodes and blows up the cone vertices, any smoothing forces a relation among link classes bounding in the local Milnor fibers. The relation is nonzero at every node and degree-seven point, and at each degree-six point smoothed through the one-dimensional component. The proof uses vanishing periods and applies to smoothing arcs of arbitrary contact order, extending the necessity direction of Friedman's criterion. We apply the obstruction to a Batyrev hypersurface whose thirty singularities are individually smoothable but which admits no smoothing, even formally. On its mirror partner, two nodes cannot be smoothed by any analytic deformation, independently of a locally nonsmoothable cone point.

entries.source_title: Berry-Esseen bounds for products of random matrices under a $2+\delta$ polynomial moment
entries.source_excerpt: Let $(g_{k})_{k \geq 1}$ be a sequence of independent and identically distributed matrices with law $\mu$ on $\mathrm{GL}(d,\mathbb{R})$, where $d\geq2$ is an integer. Suppose that the closed semigroup generated by the support of $\mu$ is strongly irreducible and proximal and that the polynomial moment of order $2+\delta$ is finite, where $0<\delta\leq 1$. We establish a Berry-Esseen bound of order $n^{-\delta/2}$ for $\log \| g_{n} \cdots g_{1} v\|$, where $v$ is a nonzero vector in $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ and $\|\cdot\|$ is an arbitrary norm on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$. As an application, we also obtain a Berry-Esseen bound of order $n^{-\delta/2}$ for $\log \| g_{n} \cdots g_{1}\|$, where $\|\cdot\|$ is any matrix norm. The proof combines an $m$-dependent approximation with Stein's method. The argument uses identities for exchangeable pairs constructed by resampling individual matrices, together with a concentration inequality for sums of the approximating variables.

entries.source_title: Unconditional Bounds for Two, Three and Four Consecutive Moderate Gaps between Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
entries.source_excerpt: We prove unconditional positive-proportion results for consecutive moderate gaps between zeros of the Riemann zeta function. More precisely, for every fixed \(00\). The proof combines Lamzouri's Hilbert-space formulation of the Montgomery--Taylor second-moment method with local spectral estimates for simple critical-line zeros and a cluster-counting argument that accounts for multiple zeros and zeros off the critical line.
entries.title_zh: 黎曼 ζ 函数零点中连续中等间距的无条件密度下界
entries.summary_zh: 论文无条件证明：对固定 0<c≤1/4，ζ 非平凡零点序列中，连续两、三、四个间距均至少为 2πc/log T 的出现比例，下极限分别不低于约 0.345、0.181 和 0.0175，以 N(T) 归一化并按重数计零点。此前相关问题曾在黎曼猜想与配对相关猜想假设下研究；证明结合 Montgomery–Taylor 二阶矩方法的 Hilbert 空间表述、临界线简单零点的局部谱估计，以及处理重零点和离线零点的簇计数。

entries.source_title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
entries.source_excerpt: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. Each newly authored template is linked to a documented source and a verbatim quote from it. Each evaluated template also has a counter-stereotypical
entries.title_zh: BanglaBBQ：面向孟加拉国情境的问答偏见基准

entries.source_title: Aspects of quadratic Chabauty via modular forms
entries.source_excerpt: We develop algorithms to construct a basis of de Rham cohomology for modular curves and a matrix representing the Hodge filtration required in the quadratic Chabauty method. We do this without requiring an explicit plane model of the curve and instead compute these objects in terms of modular forms. Our approach works for any modular curve; to demonstrate its efficiency, we implement our method for nonsplit Cartan modular curves.

entries.source_title: Free energy and fluctuations of generalized bipartite Sherrington-Kirkpatrick models and generalized Hopfield models
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the free energy of generalized bipartite Sherrington-Kirkpatrick models in the high temperature regime, with one spin normalized and the other either normalized or i.i.d. We derive a unified formula for the limiting free energy in both settings. We also prove that the fluctuations of the free energy converge to a Gaussian distribution under mild assumptions. The proof is based on a bipartite multigraph expansion, which also gives free energy results for generalized Hopfield models and log likelihood ratio of spiked rectangular models.

entries.source_title: Infinite families and sporadic solutions of the equation $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$
entries.source_excerpt: Ranjan and Singh proved that for every composite $n$ which is not twice an odd prime, $\varphi(n)$ is at least one plus the sum of $\varphi$ over the prime divisors of $n$, with equality exactly for $n=4,12,30$. \new{We study the weighted equation $\varphi(n)=c+\alpha\sum_{p\mid n}\varphi(p)$. entries.title_zh: 欧拉函数加权方程的无限族与零散解
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 φ(n)=c+αΣ_{p|n}φ(p) 等方程，刻画何时存在无限解族，并证明其余解有限且由明确线性机制产生；在给定参数范围内完全确定复合数解，同时推广至 τ、σ、Jordan totient 等函数。作者还讨论以 φ 的迭代替代素数值时的对应方程，并给出平均亏量渐近展开。

entries.source_title: A direct proof of Infinity in NF-0
entries.source_excerpt: We give a direct proof of Infinity in the no-empty version of New Foundations, denoted NF-0, by establishing that every model of the specified theory contains an object that is not finite in a precise, internally defined sense. The version considered has extensionality, at least two distinct objects, no empty objects, and inhabited stratified comprehension: a stratified extension is supplied whenever it has a member. Finiteness combines a two-sided internally represented well-order with the exclusion of internally represented nonterminating strict transitive relations on inhabited subsets. Assuming all objects finite, partial bijections yield comparison and finite extrema of positive Frege cardinals. Positive exponentiation, singleton type-raising, and the least orbit of the genuine two-cardinal lead to the equation n = T(n) + 1. We prove separately, and in detail, that adjoining one point reverses internally defined parity: the key ingredients are a graph-rewiring proof of invariance under adjoining two points and one instance of stratified induction derived from the all-finite assumption. entries.title_zh: NF-0 中无穷公理的直接证明
entries.summary_zh: 论文在无空对象的新基础集合论 NF-0 中直接证明无穷公理：在外延性、至少两个对象及可满足分层理解等条件下，不可能所有对象都按文中内部定义为有限。证明先推导有限基数比较与极值，再利用正基数、类型提升和内部奇偶性矛盾得到 n=T(n)+1 不可成立。

entries.source_title: A unified variational framework for augmented Lagrangian preconditioning of saddle point systems: applications to mixed-dimensional and fictitious domain methods
entries.source_excerpt: We present a general framework to derive augmented Lagrangian preconditioners for saddle point systems arising from mixed finite element discretizations. Our approach is based on augmenting the variational formulation at the continuous level prior to discretization, providing a unified strategy for designing efficient preconditioners that are robust under mesh refinement for a broad class of problems leading to symmetric saddle point systems. The robustness of the proposed preconditioners is established through a detailed spectral analysis. This framework is applied to different model problems, focusing on mixed-dimensional and fictitious domain formulations involving Lagrange multipliers, with some configurations featuring large coefficient jumps. Extensive numerical experiments on different test cases and geometries are presented, validating the effectiveness and robustness of our preconditioners when used in conjunction with flexible GMRES.

entries.source_title: A Sharp Distributional Lower Bound for Planar Discrepancy
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the unnormalized discrepancy function of every $n$-point set in the unit square has absolute value at least $c\sqrt{1+\log n}$ on a set of measure at least $\eta$, with absolute constants $c,\eta>0$. Consequently, its $L_p$-quasinorm is bounded below by $c\,\eta^{1/p} \sqrt{1+\log n}$ for every $p>0$.

entries.source_title: How Prompt Style Affects AI Accuracy and Speed in Competitive Programming
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models are increasingly used in competitive programming, and their outputs are sensitive to how a prompt is phrased. Prior work has compared prompt strategies for accuracy on competitive programming, but not for runtime speed, and has not situated the results against human performance. In an exploratory study of one prompt in each of nine styles on GPT-5.5 across three accuracy tasks from the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and two NP-hard speed tasks, we found that no single prompt was best: the strongest prompt depended on the task type and on whether results were summarized by the mean or the median, suggesting that, at least for these tasks, prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as universal. Many differences in mean scores came from a few outlier runs, showing that evaluating prompting by a single metric can obscure how much its effectiveness varies. Compared descriptively with human IOI contestants, who worked under different conditions, the AI was neither strictly better nor strictly worse, exceeding the average contestant on one task but falling short on the other two. entries.source_title: Scaling and Renormalization in Neural Networks: An Effective Renormalization-Group Description of Grokking
entries.source_excerpt: Grokking is a delayed transition from memorization to generalization in deep neural networks (NNs). We examine whether scaling and renormalization group (RG) theories can describe this dynamics, establishing a quantitative physical framework for neural generalization transitions. For modular addition on a two-layer NN, an ensemble of trained models defines an order parameter (the squared weight norm) and fluctuation proxies for the heat capacity and the susceptibility, with training epoch and weight decay serving as thermal and field control coordinates. To bridge neural architectures to real-space RG, we construct an exact coupling matrix via a second-order expansion of the loss with respect to per-neuron norms and use its Fiedler vector to define an effective geometry. This spectral ordering yields a monotonic spatial decay of coupling strength that is absent under random permutations. We then execute real-space RG by block-spin aggregating adjacent neurons and parameterizing the coupling matrix into off-diagonal band strengths. entries.title_zh: 用重整化群描述神经网络的 grokking

entries.source_title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
entries.source_excerpt: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. entries.title_zh: PerMIT：用机器检查完整性定理保护智能体持久记忆

entries.source_title: National Security Agency (NSA) and world leaders warn of security flaws found in PHP programming language
entries.source_excerpt: NSA 警告两个由 Calif 研究人员用 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现的 PHP 关键漏洞（PHP2Shell），敦促组织打补丁或将未修补服务器下线。两个漏洞位于 PHP 核心，在 Apache mod_php 上演示的利用可在应用代码运行前触发。
entries.title_zh: NSA 等机构警告 PHP 存在严重安全漏洞
entries.summary_zh: 这条转述称，两项 PHP 核心漏洞可能在应用层代码运行前触发内存破坏，NSA 建议立即升级或下线未修补服务器；PHP 于 10 月 21 日为多个维护分支发布修复版本。材料还称攻击已在补丁发布前出现，并引用约 510 万个运行 PHP 的 IP、其中约 75.8 万使用无补丁支持版本的统计；这些数字来自转帖引用的数据，应结合官方公告和自身资产清单核验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对 PHP 站点运营者有紧急排查价值，尤其要识别已停止支持的旧分支。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应立即核对官方修复版本并安排升级或隔离。
entries.cynic_review: 转帖中的扫描统计需核实口径，不能直接当成受影响主机数。
entries.paper_review: 主要价值在安全响应，不是新研究结果。

entries.source_title: Lattice Moduli and Residual Atoms
entries.source_excerpt: We study prescribed holomorphic lattices for regular-singular connections and residual factors of quantum $F$-bundles. For an arbitrary ordered monodromy spectrum, we classify the fully framed local groupoid: each residue fibre is a discrete affine space of dimension $r(r-1)$, with a unique normal form and trivial stabilisers. We then analyse elementary changes of lattice. A strictly positive integral residue difference obstructs the oriented wall; otherwise, in arbitrary rank, the extending normal-form arcs form an affine torsor of relative dimension $r(r-1)$, and specialisation to the shifted residue slice is polynomial and triangular by root height. Adjacent walls exhibit the composite-root correction dictated by the type-$A$ root-subgroup relations, while an example over the dual numbers detects a nilpotent saturation defect. For one-branch $F$-bundles, the scalar branch is recovered from the residual trace, and scalar residualisation yields a symmetric monoidal equivalence with zero-branch $F$-bundles. This construction yields residual atoms, functorial Jordan strata, and a residual chemical formula compatible with blow-ups and p
entries.title_zh: 格模空间与剩余原子
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究正则奇点联络的指定全纯格及量子 F-丛的剩余因子，并对任意有序单值谱分类完全标记的局部群胚：每个剩余纤维是维数 r(r−1) 的离散仿射空间，有唯一标准形且稳定子平凡。随后分析格的初等变化，给出正整数剩余差何时阻断有向墙，以及一般秩下延拓标准形弧的仿射扭子结构和多项式特化规律。

entries.paper_review: 给出完全标记局部分类及初等格变化的结构描述。

entries.source_title: On AI statements in mathematics papers
entries.source_excerpt: “Over the past year, many people have written eloquently and at length on the continuously improving power of generative AI (Large Language Models or LLMs) for research mathematics. Opinions range over the entire spectrum from negative to positive, but all seem to agree that mathematics is going through a period of enormous change […]”
entries.title_zh: 数学论文中的 AI 使用声明
entries.summary_zh: Hendrik De Bie 抽查 2026 年 9 月 14 日至 18 日 arXiv 的 math.CA 与 math.RT 新投稿，共 152 篇，并联系作者询问 AI 使用情况；其中 85 篇没有声明，53 篇声明在数学工作中使用 AI，另有 6 篇声明未使用 AI、8 篇仅用于其他用途。作者据此建议明确说明未使用 AI 的情况，并在用于数学工作时交代模型、用途和涉及部分；他提醒样本范围有限，且调查可能低估实际使用。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 文章提供了一个范围明确的 AI 声明小型调查，并给出撰写方法说明时可参考的披露要素。
entries.pragmatic_review: 模型、用途、涉及章节和资助关系等披露维度可直接用于起草 AI 声明。

entries.source_title: Secondary Chow Invariants beyond Lawson--Massey Products
entries.source_excerpt: We construct secondary Chow invariants that cannot be recovered from Lawson--Massey realization. For every smooth complex projective curve $C$ of positive genus and every $n\ge2$, explicit cubical defining systems yield $n$ distinct Massey values in $\rm{CH}^{3}(C\times P^{2},1)$, with zero full indeterminacy, forming a cyclic group of order $n$. All corresponding triples have identical morphic classes and zero morphic, Lawson, and singular Massey brackets, despite nonzero target groups. The values are detected by the Weil pairing. We further construct secondary quotient classes of every finite order on smooth projective varieties with ample canonical bundle in every dimension at least two, and prove that generically finite pullbacks of coprime degree preserve their exact orders. These constructions obstruct integral and prime-local motivic formality, although the corresponding brackets become $\{0\}$ after reduction modulo every integer $m\ge2$. All specified values are torsion and vanish after rationalization.
entries.title_zh: 超越 Lawson–Massey 乘积的次级 Chow 不变量
entries.summary_zh: 论文构造无法由 Lawson–Massey 实现恢复的次级 Chow 不变量：对任意正亏格光滑复射影曲线 C 及 n≥2，得到 CH³(C×P²,1) 中 n 个无完全不确定性的 Massey 值，组成 n 阶循环群，而相应 morphic、Lawson 与奇异 Massey 括号均为零。Weil 配对可检测这些值；作者还在任意维数至少二、典范丛充足的光滑射影簇上构造任意有限阶次级商类。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 展示 Chow 理论中存在被传统 Lawson–Massey 不变量遗漏、但可由算术配对检测的次级结构。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合高阶代数循环与动机不变量研究。
entries.cynic_review: 构造依赖特定几何对象与高阶定义，应用需掌握相应 Chow 群背景。
entries.paper_review: 明确构造非平凡新不变量并说明旧实现为何无法检测。

entries.source_title: Short proof that Vop\v{e}nka's Principle is symmetrically stable
entries.source_excerpt: We show that Vop\v{e}nka's Principle is stable under symmetric extensions. Recently, de Groot and Woloszyn [1] proved this fact. We found the proof of this theorem unnecessarily complicated. In this short note we prove the same statement. We direct the reader to [3] for an exposition on symmetric extensions.

entries.source_title: Asymptotics of local height pairing without Hodge conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: We remove the assumption of the Hodge conjecture from the asymptotic formula for the Archimedean local height established in our previous work. We also remove other minor assumptions. We achieve this by exploiting the cohomological nature of Beilinson's local intersection index rather than arguing motivically.

entries.source_title: Almost-optimal bulk regularity conditions in the CLT for G$\beta$E
entries.source_excerpt: We consider linear statistics $\sum_{k=1}^N f(x_k)$ of a Gaussian $\b$-ensemble. Following the work of \cite{LaSo22}, which was concerned only with Wigner matrices, we extend their results for general $\b$. In particular, we show that the CLT holds for any $f \in H^{1/2 + \e}$. The novel input which was not used in \cite{LaSo22} is the Helffer-Sj\"ostrand representation for the covariance, first appearing the random matrix context in \cite{ErYa15}, coupled with characteristic flow estimates for DBM, first appearing in \cite{Bo22}.

entries.source_title: On the unit group of some triquadratic fields
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we calculate the unit groups and the $2$-class numbers of the fields $ \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2}, \sqrt{q}, \sqrt{rs})$, where $q\equiv3\pmod4$, $r$ and $s$ are distinct prime numbers satisfying some congruent conditions. As an application of our main results, we derive the precise 2-class number for each field in our family. Furthermore, we show that Greenberg's conjecture is verified for several infinite families of real biquadratic fields.

entries.source_title: Proposing Better Rollouts for On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model post-training by letting the student learn from its own sampled trajectories under teacher supervision, aligning the training process with inference-time behavior. However, the rollout policy in OPD is usually treated as fixed: each round samples directly from the current student. We show that this choice can create a compounding teacher--student mismatch, because it requires the teacher to provide effective supervision on whichever trajectories the student samples, including ones less reachable by the teacher itself. On such trajectories, teacher supervision can become noisy or even misleading, leading to undesirable student patterns such as repetition. Moreover, since the updated student in turn defines the rollout policy of subsequent rounds, these patterns persist and potentially amplify over training. This failure mode suggests that improving OPD requires treating the rollout policy itself as an optimization target, rather than only modifying the distillation objective. entries.source_title: Nonintersecting Unit Diagonals in Odd Square Arrays
entries.source_excerpt: Let $D(n)$ be the maximum number of unit-square diagonals in an $n\times n$ square array such that no two selected diagonals share an endpoint and no unit square contains both diagonals. We prove that, for every odd positive integer $n$, $D(n)=n(n+1)/2+\lfloor(n+1)/6\rfloor$. The matching lower bound was established by Boyland, Roth, Pint\'er, Lauk\'o, Schoenfield, and Wasielewski. We obtain the upper bound by transforming any admissible selection $M$ in a $(2k-1)\times(2k-1)$ square array into an isometric path cover of the $k\times k$ vertex grid with at most $2k^2-|M|$ paths. An auxiliary matching decomposes the original vertices into alternating paths. On each such path, all segments between blocks are either of type $da$ or of type $bc$. Projecting these paths to the block grid gives coordinate-monotone sequences, which become geodesics when diagonal steps are expanded. The Fisher--Fitzpatrick theorem then yields the sharp upper bound. We also describe a Lean verification of the upper-bound reduction, with the grid-cover theorem supplied as an explicit hypothesis.
entries.title_zh: 奇数边长方阵中互不相交的单位对角线
entries.summary_zh: 在边长 n 为奇数的 n×n 方格阵内选单位正方形对角线，要求任意两条无共同端点且同一小格不同时选两条。论文证明最大数恰为 n(n+1)/2+⌊(n+1)/6⌋；下界已有前人给出，本文通过把选取转成顶点网格上的等距路径覆盖证明锐上界，并给出 Lean 形式化的上界归约，网格覆盖定理仍作为显式假设。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 组合极值问题并带形式化证明组件，适合离散几何与 Lean 读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把局部对角线配置转成网格最短路径是核心构造。
entries.cynic_review: 上界有结构化路径覆盖证明，且清楚标出形式化假设。
entries.paper_review: 形式化部分并未认证整个组合定理，因为关键覆盖引理仍是假设。

entries.source_title: Singular vectors of sparse random rectangular matrices: Transition between delocalized and semilocalized phases
entries.source_excerpt: Consider the bipartite Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi graph $\mathbb{G}(n,m,d/\sqrt{mn})$ at the critical sparsity $d = b\log(N)$ for some $b > 0$ with $N = n + m$, and constant aspect ratio $\gamma = n/m \geq 1$. We show that the spectrum of its centered and rescaled bi-adjacency matrix, whose limiting law is the Mar\v{c}enko--Pastur (MP) distribution, is split into two phases: in the bulk, singular vectors are completely delocalized, while near the edges, singular vectors are semilocalized, with their mass concentrating on small disjoint balls, centered at vertices with extreme degrees. As $b$ decreases, we identify sharp thresholds for the emergence of outlier singular values. For explicit $b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ and $b_{\rm L}^{\star}$ as functions of $\gamma$, we prove that when $b > b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, there is no outlier outside the bulk; when $b_{\rm L}^{\star}< b < b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, only right outliers emerge; and when $b < b_{\rm L}^{\star}$, outliers are present on both sides, all with high probability. This removes an extra technical condition from our previous work arxiv:2508.01456, providing a complete characterization of the paramete
entries.title_zh: 稀疏随机矩形矩阵奇异向量的离域与半局域化相变
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究临界稀疏度 d=b log(n+m)、固定长宽比的二部 Erdős–Rényi 图邻接矩阵，证明中心化缩放后的奇异向量在谱主体区完全离域，在谱边缘半局域化并集中于极端度顶点附近的小球。作者给出依赖长宽比的左右离群奇异值阈值：b 高于右阈值时无离群值，两阈值之间只出现右离群值，低于左阈值时两侧均出现；该结果补全先前工作的额外技术条件，并结合局部 MP 定律与正则化随机图非回溯矩阵谱半径界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合随机矩阵与网络谱分析读者理解稀疏度如何控制奇异向量局部化和谱离群值。
entries.pragmatic_review: 左右阈值分类有助于判断极端度节点何时主导谱边缘。
entries.cynic_review: 结论限于临界对数稀疏区和固定长宽比设定。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出完整阈值分区和关键工具，阈值公式需看论文正文。

entries.source_title: On tame amenable flows and generalized Newelski's conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: We are developing some topological dynamics below a given ambit. We define and study Bohr compactifications below ambits and other related objects. We describe a natural epimorphism from the Ellis group of an ambit to the Bohr compactification below its Ellis semigroup ambit. The first main result says that, assuming tameness and hereditary amenability, this natural map is an isomorphism of topological groups. This is an abstract dynamical generalization of Newelski's conjecture, or rather a theorem of Chernikov and Simon that a natural map from the Ellis group of the flow $(S_G(M),G)$ to the definable Bohr compactification of $G$ is an isomorphism when $G$ is a definably amenable group definable in a NIP structure $M$. We give two proofs of our main result: a shorter dynamical proof and an analytic proof. In the course of the dynamical proof, we prove some results on the universal compactification flow and on the generalized Bohr compactification below a given ambit which admits a left continuous semigroup operation extending the action of $G$. entries.title_zh: 温和可解流与广义 Newelski 猜想
entries.summary_zh: 作者研究给定 ambit 下的 Bohr 紧化及其与 Ellis 半群的关系，证明在 tame（温和）和遗传可解条件下，从 Ellis 群到对应 Bohr 紧化的自然满同态实际上是拓扑群同构。结果推广了可定义 amenable NIP 群情形下的相关 Newelski 定理，并提供动力学与解析两种证明。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合拓扑动力系统、模型论群与可定义动力学。
entries.pragmatic_review: Bohr 紧化捕捉群作用的最大紧致群因子。
entries.cynic_review: 把已有群论结论推广至一般 ambit 框架。
entries.paper_review: tame、遗传可解与 ambit 术语需要专业背景。

entries.source_title: When Stable and Preferred Semantics Agree: A Path-Based Approach
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate structural conditions under which preferred and stable semantics agree in abstract argumentation frameworks. Our approach is based on suitably chosen sets of paths in the attack graph and binary relations induced by them. We establish a general path-based criterion for semantic agreement and instantiate it with several classes of paths, obtaining sufficient conditions expressed in terms of well-foundedness of the corresponding relations. The resulting conditions strictly generalize two principal structural criteria for preferred and stable agreement in the literature: Dung's limited controversiality condition and the SCC-symmetry condition. In particular, Dung's result is recovered as a special case by taking the relevant path set to be the set of even paths. We further introduce two infinite sequences of path sets, each yielding a family of agreement conditions. For the first sequence, a Collapse Theorem reduces the infinitely many associated well-foundedness conditions to three essentially distinct ones, whereas the second sequence gives rise to genuinely distinct conditions with no analogous collapse. entries.title_zh: 用攻击图路径刻画稳定与优选论证语义一致
entries.summary_zh: 论文在抽象论证框架的攻击图中选取路径集合，以所诱导关系的良基性给出稳定语义和优选语义一致的充分条件。该框架推广两类既有判据，并讨论两组无限路径条件，其中一组可压缩为三类、另一组保持真正不同。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合知识表示、论证推理与图结构分析。

entries.paper_review: 路径层次揭示旧判据间的联系。

entries.source_title: Generating functions of hypermaps and m-constellations with two alternating boundaries
entries.source_excerpt: We study the enumeration of planar hypermaps with several alternating boundaries. We first derive a peeling recursion with an arbitrary number of alternating boundaries and, in the two- boundary case, translate it into a functional equation for the corresponding generating function. Our main result is an explicit solution of this equation for m-constellations. In particular, we obtain a rational expression for the genus-zero two-point function, or cylinder generating function, with two alternating boundaries.
entries.title_zh: 具有两条交替边界的超图映射与 m-星座生成函数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究带有多条交替边界的平面 hypermap 枚举，先建立适用于任意边界数的剥离递归，再在两边界情形转化为生成函数函数方程。主要结果是显式求解 m-constellation 的方程，特别得到亏格零两点（圆柱）生成函数的有理表达式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合组合拓扑与随机地图研究者了解边界结构如何进入可解的枚举方程。
entries.pragmatic_review: 递归到函数方程的路径可供相近地图枚举问题借鉴。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要聚焦两边界的显式解，任意边界情形未给出同等封闭公式。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述递归和有理解结果，系数与变量约定需看正文。

entries.source_title: Modular Existential Closedness
entries.source_excerpt: We prove the Modular Existential Closedness conjecture for the modular $j$-function extended from the upper half-plane to $\mathbb{C} \setminus \mathbb{R}$ by Schwarz reflection. Specifically, we show that any system of equations involving the field operations and $j$ has solutions in the complex numbers unless it is overdetermined. Such a system is overdetermined if, roughly, there are more independent equations than variables, possibly after applying the transformation rules of the $j$-function under the linear fractional action of $\rm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{Q})$ on $\mathbb{C} \setminus \mathbb{R}$. In general, we do not expect overdetermined systems of equations to have solutions due to the algebraic and transcendental properties of the $j$-function captured by the modular analogue of Schanuel's conjecture. entries.title_zh: 模存在闭性猜想
entries.summary_zh: 作者证明扩展到 C\R 的模 j 函数满足 Modular Existential Closedness 猜想：广义“自由”且“广阔”的代数簇与 j 图形应存在交点，除非方程数目过多。它是 modular 版本 Schanuel 型独立性的几何表达；文章还明确由 j 函数在 PGL₂(Q) 作用下的变换规则决定何时系统可能超定。

entries.paper_review: 技术条件中的 broad/free 有精确定义，摘要化描述不能代替定理。

entries.source_title: Optimization-based Cell Average Limiters as Metric Projections: Constrained Evolution and Convergence Analysis for Convection-diffusion Equations
entries.source_excerpt: The optimization-based cell average limiter enforces global conservation and bounds, and has been successfully applied to discontinuous Galerkin (DG) discretizations of a wide range of nonlinear systems, from phase-field models to the compressible Navier-Stokes equations. In this paper, taking the heat and convection-diffusion equations as prototypes, we analyze the convergence of the scheme resulting from cell average limiting. Encoding conservation and admissibility in a differential inclusion identifies the limiter as a backward Euler proximal step in a Lie splitting of the constrained evolution. This proximal step is the metric projection onto the convex admissible set, and we prove that it is nonexpansive and stable in the $L^2$ norm, and that it does not increase the total variation of the cell averages. Combined with the standard error analysis, nonexpansiveness yields an $O(\tau+h^{k+1})$ estimate for implicit Euler time stepping with DG discretization of polynomial degree $k$ under a reverse CFL condition, together with an unconditional $O(\tau+h^{k})$ estimate. entries.title_zh: 把单元平均限制器解释为约束演化的度量投影
entries.summary_zh: 作者把 DG 中保持守恒和可容许界的单元平均限制器表示为约束演化的 backward Euler 近端步骤，也就是对凸可容许集的度量投影。证明该投影在 L² 中非扩张且不增加单元平均总变差，结合误差分析得到隐式 Euler 的 O(τ+h^{k+1}) 估计，并给无条件 O(τ+h^k) 界。
