entries.source_title: ODAT-SE: A modular and parallel framework for simulation-based inverse problems
entries.source_excerpt: Open Data Analysis Tool for Science and Engineering (ODAT-SE) is an open-source Python framework for inverse problems that are solved by repeated forward simulations. It succeeds 2DMAT, which was developed for surface-structure analysis with quantum-beam diffraction and has since been applied to other fields. In version 3, the search algorithms were separated from the application-specific solvers, which became independent packages, and the software was renamed; this paper describes the current version 4.0. The framework connects optimization and sampling algorithms to solvers through a common interface for parameter mapping, constraints, and objective evaluation, so that an existing simulation code can be used with any of the algorithms. Relative to the previously published 2DMAT, it provides two-level MPI parallelism, which distributes candidate evaluations over processes and each evaluation over a parallel solver, checkpoint and continuation facilities, random search, global optimizers from SciPy, tensor-train optimization, and a Bayesian workflow that estimates partition-function ratios, model evidence, effective noise levels, and

entries.source_title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
entries.source_excerpt: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. entries.source_title: PArcK trees can get as hot as you want
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the combinatorial game Partizan Arc Kayles as a generalization of Domineering. An extensive technical search using genetic algorithms found hot positions of temperature exceeding 2. We discuss this search and construct a family of positions with high temperature that includes these graphs and prove that Partizan Arc Kayles has unbounded temperature. We identify an infinite family of second-player win positions as part of our main construction.

entries.source_title: Sharp Bounds on the Winner's Bias under Independent and Nonnegatively Correlated Noise
entries.source_excerpt: Reporting the best of $M$ noisy, unbiased scores overstates the winner's value by up to $c\sqrt{V}$, where $V$ is the total noise variance and the sharp constant $c$ depends on how the noise is dependent. It was known only at the two extremes, arbitrary dependence ($\sqrt{(M-1)/M}$) and i.i.d. noise. We determine it for two classes in between: for independent, not identically distributed noise it is $\sqrt{(M-1)/(2M)}$, and for pairwise nonnegatively correlated noise it is $(M-1)/M$; for uncorrelated noise this answers the maximum version of an open question about the expected range. Explicit finite constructions attain both. As a corollary, the bias of the cross-validation estimator is bounded sharply within each class. All theorems are formally verified in Lean 4. Across 448 language-model and classifier selection pipelines, designs with per-candidate items realize a median 0.75 of the independent-class ceiling. At a fixed item budget, scoring all candidates on shared items is markedly less optimistic than giving each candidate its own items.
entries.title_zh: 独立或非负相关噪声下 winner’s bias 的尖锐界
entries.summary_zh: 从 M 个无偏噪声分数中挑最大者会高估赢家真实值；论文补齐独立异分布与两两非负相关两类依赖结构下的尖锐常数，分别为 √((M−1)/(2M)) 与 (M−1)/M，并给出达到界的有限构造。结果也给交叉验证估计器的尖锐偏差界；Lean 4 形式化验证了定理，实验显示共享测试样本比每个候选使用独立样本更不乐观。

entries.source_title: A configurational numerical viscosity for thermodynamically compatible finite volume schemes of compressible multiphase flows
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the fluid subsystem of a variationally derived hyperbolic thermodynamically compatible (HTC) model of compressible multiphase flows. Its total energy is in general not convex in the natural state variables, so a scalar numerical viscosity acting on them need not produce non-negative entropy. Reformulating the equations in terms of the volume fractions separates changes in the amount of each phase from changes in its intrinsic state. This guides the construction of a configurational numerical viscosity in phase variables, in which the energy is convex, while the scheme retains the structure of the HTC model. At the semi-discrete level, the new schemes satisfy: I) local conservation of the phase masses, the mixture momentum and the total energy; II) a cell entropy inequality whose production is non-negative face by face and phase by phase, with no convexity assumption in the evolved variables and no clipping; III) positivity of the partial densities and volume fractions under explicit time-step conditions; IV) exact preservation of contact equilibria; V) equivalence with a scheme for the density-weighted volume fractions. entries.source_title: Triple Products of Correlated Multivariate Hermite Polynomials
entries.source_excerpt: Stochastic Galerkin schemes (SGS) are used to approximate solutions to differential equations with stochastic parameters. In particular, they express the solution with an infinite orthogonal functional basis of the parameter space and derive a deterministic system of PDEs; the solution of this deterministic system can be used to produce a {surrogate} approximation of the original stochastic equations. When the parameters are correlated, the infinite series representation of the solution does not provably converge for all joint distributions; further, classic decorrelating transformations (e.g., Roseblatt) often introduce known numerical instabilities. Rahman (2017) established convergence in probability and distribution for correlated {Gaussian} parameters when the basis functionals are {multivariate Hermite polynomials} (MHPs), where these polynomials are only {weakly orthogonal} with respect to the underlying joint density. Due to weak orthogonality, the $N$th moments of MHPs introduced during Galerkin projection do not trivially decompose into products of one-dimensional expectations and have no closed-form expression for $N > 2$;
entries.title_zh: 相关多元 Hermite 多项式的精确三重积

entries.source_title: Stationary Half-space Geometric Last Passage Percolation without Random Shift
entries.source_excerpt: We derive exact formulas for the diagonal distribution of half-space geometric last-passage percolation with a two-parameter family of stationary initial conditions throughout the phase diagram. Unlike previous results, our formulas remove the random shift at the origin. Under critical scaling, we obtain new formulas for the half-space stationary KPZ fixed-point distribution at $x=0$ in the high-density and maximal-current phases. In the low-density phase, we derive a new representation and show that it matches the corresponding formula from the stationary log-gamma polymer.

entries.source_title: There is no universal $F_σ$ equivalence relation
entries.source_excerpt: Rosendal proved that any $K_\sigma$ equivalence relation is Borel reducible to $\ell_\infty$. We prove that for every $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation $F$ on a Polish space, there is an $F_\sigma$ real linear subspace $H$ of $\ell_2$ such that the coset relation $x\mathrel{E_H}y$ if and only if $x-y\in H$ has no Baire-measurable reduction to $F$. In particular, there is no $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation universal under Borel reducibility for all $F_\sigma$ equivalence relations. This answers a question of Rosendal.
entries.title_zh: 不存在通用的 Fσ 等价关系
entries.summary_zh: 论文声称对任意 Polish 空间上的 Fσ 等价关系，都能构造 ℓ² 中的 Fσ 实线性子空间，使其陪集关系无法 Baire 可测地归约到前者。因此所有 Fσ 等价关系在 Borel 归约下没有通用对象，回答 Rosendal 的问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合描述集合论中的分类复杂度。
entries.pragmatic_review: 澄清一类等价关系不存在统一编码目标。
entries.cynic_review: 需区分 Fσ 与既有 Kσ 结论。
entries.paper_review: 线性子空间反例给出更强不可归约性。

entries.source_title: Volterra-Skorokhod Reflection and Fluid Limits of Loss Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In the $G_t/G/n/n$ loss queue, a customer blocked at time $u$ remains missing from the system for as long as it would have been served. A fraction $K(t-u)$ of the blocking at $u$ therefore still affects the occupancy at time $t$, where $K=1-G$ is the service survival function. We show that, for every arrival process satisfying a functional strong law of large numbers, the fluid limit of this queue is a reflection with kernel $K$ of the fluid limit of the associated infinite-server queue. The reflection is defined by a one-sided reflection problem on $(-\infty,1]$ in which the regulator is convolved with a memory kernel. Given a c\`adl\`ag input $\rho$ and a kernel $K$ with $K(0)=1$, we seek a pair $(\hat\rho,\eta)$ such that $\hat\rho=\rho-\int_0^\cdot K(\cdot-u)\,d\eta(u)$ takes values in $(-\infty,1]$, $\eta$ is nondecreasing, and $\eta$ increases only when $\hat\rho=1$. entries.source_title: A Central Limit Theorem for Intrinsic Fr\'echet Means on Real Grassmannians
entries.source_excerpt: Subspace-valued data arise in dimension reduction, image-set and video recognition, and signal processing, and the Fr\'echet mean is their standard sample mean [11,9,15,23]. We establish a central limit theorem for the intrinsic sample Fr\'echet mean of i.i.d. observations on the real Grassmann manifold $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$, as a specialization of the general theorem of [18]. Unlike prior results which require the distribution to vanish or place negligible mass near the cut locus of the population mean, we allow a continuous, possibly positive density. To enable our results, we derive two properties of $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$: the first is that the union of the cut loci of all points within distance $\delta$ of the mean has volume $O(\delta)$. The second is that the Hessian of the squared distance function is integrable. We also give a smooth density on $\mathrm{Gr}(1,2)$ for which the mean is unique but the Fr\'echet Hessian vanishes.

entries.source_title: Reusable QUBO-Derived Block-Schur Inverse Factors for Fixed-Operator Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
entries.source_excerpt: Many simulations of partial differential equations require the repeated solution of linear systems whose matrix remains fixed while the righthand side changes. We present a hybrid offline online framework for this setting. The discretized operator is organized into small coupled blocks and reduced through block Schur complements. Instead of expressing the complete PDE solution as one large binary optimization problem, quadratic unconstrained binary optimization is used only to construct reusable local inverse factors. These factors are computed during an offline stage, decoded and stored, and then reused in an ordinary classical block solve for subsequent righthand sides. The optimizer facing problem size is governed by the local block size and chosen numerical precision, rather than by the dimension of the full spatial grid. entries.source_title: A high-order multi-scale method and its error analysis for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems in composite materials
entries.source_excerpt: Significant spatial heterogeneity and nonlocal history-dependent attenuation jointly govern wave propagation in composite materials, making full-scale direct numerical simulation (DNS) computationally prohibitive. This study proposed a high-order multi-scale (HOMS) method for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems with highly oscillatory and discontinuous material coefficients. Using a multi-scale asymptotic expansion approach, the macroscopic homogenized equation, and first- and second-order correction terms are derived to construct the high-accuracy HOMS solution. Moreover, a local pointwise error analysis identifies the leading residual eliminated by this HOMS solution and validates its local physical balance preservation. Then, a global energy-norm error estimate establishes the $O(\varepsilon)$-order convergence rate for the HOMS solution. entries.recommend_reason_zh: 研究机器人操作、触觉感知或多模态行为学习的人，可以从数据模态、设备设计和任务范围了解这一数据资源，并评估其是否与自己的硬件或训练流程匹配。
entries.pragmatic_review: 具身智能研究者可先查看样例、数据格式和设备说明，判断是否具备使用这类机器人数据所需的环境。
entries.cynic_review: 页面同时称计划开放超过 10,000 小时、目前发布 1,000 小时，且本批次以自有设备采集为主，跨设备泛化仍需实际评估。
entries.paper_review: 材料链接了 TacClaw-Infinity 论文与代码，但此处摘录未包含论文实验、完整数据质量审计或独立复现结果。

project_insight.translation_zh: Daimon-Infinity 是一个面向具身智能的多模态机器人数据集，包含高分辨率触觉感知。项目称为应对精细操作数据瓶颈，将向整个行业开放超过 10,000 小时的视觉—触觉—语言—动作（VTLA）多模态数据；其目标是建立以触觉为中心的具身智能数据生态。项目目前发布了首批 1,000 小时数据。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一套结合视觉、触觉、语言与动作信息、用于研究机器人精细操作的多模态数据集。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查阅数据集许可、样例数据、数据格式与元数据说明，再确认研究用途符合 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 的非商业及署名、相同方式共享要求；之后可从小规模样例检查传感器字段与占位值，再规划训练或可视化流程。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 许可证为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，不适合不符合其非商业与共享条款的用途。项目称首批发布 1,000 小时，超过 10,000 小时为计划目标；摘录未完整呈现数据结构与统计，也未提供可审查的独立数据质量评估。
use_cases_zh: 研究机器人抓取、分拣、装配等任务中的视觉与触觉融合。
比较不同操作设备采集的数据，并分析动作、姿态和语言标注的关系。
为具身智能模型的数据需求调研提供数据模态与格式参考。

entries.source_title: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein
entries.source_excerpt: 5.6B open weights. Text-to-image, editing, bounding boxes
entries.title_zh: FLUX 3 Image Klein：5.6B 参数图像生成与编辑模型空间
entries.summary_zh: 来源摘要将其描述为拥有 5.6B 开放权重、支持文生图、图像编辑和边界框的项目；提供的材料只有 Hugging Face Space 的说明文件片段，没有模型卡、具体能力说明或评测结果。因此，现有信息只能确认页面的自述功能，无法据此判断生成质量、编辑效果或边界框能力的具体表现。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 如果个人研究涉及图像生成、编辑或边界框任务，这个 Space 值得先查看其交互方式和模型说明；目前材料不足以判断它是否适合科研复现或本地部署。
entries.pragmatic_review: 列出的三类图像任务对个人探索有明确方向，但摘录没有展示使用流程、效果示例或访问条件。
entries.cynic_review: “开放权重”是来源摘要中的描述，材料没有给出权重许可或使用限制，Space 配置还标注了 Hugging Face OAuth。
entries.paper_review: 提供的内容仅有 Space 元数据和简短摘要，没有论文、模型卡、评测方法、代码细节或可复现结果。

project_insight.translation_zh: “5.6B 开放权重。支持文生图、图像编辑和边界框。”
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 这是一个 Hugging Face Spaces 页面，来源摘要称其关联的 5.6B 权重模型支持文生图、图像编辑和边界框任务。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查看 Hugging Face Space 页面上的模型说明、许可和访问要求，再用不含敏感信息的示例输入体验其公开界面；若考虑下载或集成权重，先确认权重许可、模型来源和推理条件。

use_cases_zh: 试用文生图并观察模型对指定提示的响应。
探索图像编辑任务，比较输入图像与输出结果。
初步查看边界框相关能力是否适合个人视觉任务原型。

entries.source_title: Structure-Preserving Dimension Reduction and Surrogates for Partially Linear Bayesian Inverse Problems
entries.source_excerpt: Many Bayesian inverse problems are characterized by two parameter vectors with distinct roles. A medium property, operator coefficient, or geometry block enters the forward model nonlinearly, whereas a volumetric, initial condition, or boundary condition source enters linearly. General-purpose nonlinear surrogates must relearn this known source dependence from data and may not preserve the correct source scaling outside the training regime. We introduce a structure-preserving partially linear (SPPL) framework that constructs separate reduced spaces for outputs, (linearly appearing) sources, and (nonlinearly appearing) medium variables and represents the reduced forward map as an affine function of the retained source coordinates, with coefficients that depend on the medium variables. Here, "affine" refers to the retained, mean-centered source coordinates: the physical forward map remains linear in the source, while the affine offset is induced by the source-prior mean and vanishes when that mean is zero. The analysis first identifies the optimal blockwise ridge approximation and then derives the optimal affine-in-source approximation
entries.title_zh: 保留源项线性结构的贝叶斯反问题降维代理
entries.summary_zh: 论文区分非线性介质参数与线性源参数，为各变量和输出分别降维，并让代理在保留的源坐标上维持仿射结构。作者分解误差并控制先验预测的期望 KL，在同震例子中报告代理 MCMC 的在线加速；均值引起的偏置不改变物理模型的源线性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合偏微分方程反演和结构化代理建模。

entries.cynic_review: 加速需计入训练成本和后验偏差。
entries.paper_review: 独立先验与高斯源下的最优性条件很关键。

entries.source_title: ​Personal Agent走向真实任务，蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1-flash-1019
entries.title_zh: 蚂蚁开源 Ling-3.1-flash-1019，瞄准真实任务个人代理
entries.summary_zh: 目前只有标题，显示蚂蚁百灵发布开源模型 Ling-3.1-flash-1019，并将其定位到 Personal Agent 的真实任务场景。正文缺失，模型能力、许可证、权重开放范围、工具使用和评测成绩都无法核实。

entries.source_title: Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: For decades, a fundamental question about the difficulty of computing in high-dimensional spaces has resisted proof. New research resolves this question, removing a major theoretical obstacle to understanding the efficiency of randomized algorithms used across science and computing. The Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture was proposed in 1995. It asks whether, for a broad class of high-dimensional […] The post Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture appeared first on Microsoft Research .
entries.title_zh: 攻克提出 31 年的数学挑战：KLS 猜想
entries.summary_zh: 微软研究者与合作者宣布解决高维几何和概率中的 Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits（KLS）猜想；该猜想关注凸体被等概率切分时，最小化割面边界的几何控制，与凸体的等周型不等式和随机游走混合性质有关。页面以平直切割与更小的弯曲切割示意差异，并称研究结合新数学思想与人类引导的 AI；这是机构新闻稿对研究成果的报道，证明细节和 AI 实际参与环节应以论文为准。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 涉及高维凸几何的重要长期猜想，并公开讨论人类引导 AI 在研究中的作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可作为追踪 KLS 及 AI 辅助数学研究的入口，需进一步阅读原论文。
entries.cynic_review: 新闻稿的成功叙事不等于独立核验，定理表述与证明贡献须查论文。
entries.paper_review: 若论文结论成立，将是高维几何与概率的重大进展。

entries.source_title: From Wheel to Jahangir graphs: spectra and energy under structured edge deletion
entries.source_excerpt: The energy of a graph, introduced by Gutman, is defined as the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix. In this work we study how the energy of the Wheel graph $W_n$ changes when a specific set of spokes is removed. The resulting graphs are precisely the Jahangir graphs $J_{m,n}$, where m divides n, and which may also be viewed as the Cycle graph $C_n$ together with an additional vertex adjacent to certain vertices of $C_n$ in a cyclic pattern. We determine the spectra of $J_{2,n}$, $J_{4,n}$, and $J_{6,n}$ by exploiting a factorization of their characteristic polynomials arising from equitable partitions. This yields explicit closed formulas for their energies. Moreover, under certain conditions, we establish the following monotonicity chain: \[\mathcal{E}(C_n) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{6,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{4,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{2,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(W_n).\]
entries.title_zh: 从轮图到 Jahangir 图：结构删边下的谱与图能量
entries.summary_zh: 论文从轮图删除按周期排列的若干辐条得到 Jahangir 图，利用等价划分分解特征多项式，求出 J₂,n、J₄,n、J₆,n 的谱及能量闭式。对满足特定条件的 n，作者进一步证明环图、Jahangir 图到轮图的能量呈单调递增链。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 通过图对称性降低谱计算难度，并把谱结果转化为图能量比较。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结构化图的特征值可直接用于相关谱图论计算。
entries.cynic_review: 能量单调关系只在论文给定条件下成立。
entries.paper_review: 等价划分提供了清晰的特征多项式分解工具。

entries.source_title: Is Token Confidence Just Chain Length? A Signal-Processing Audit of Reasoning Traces
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning language models answer math problems by writing long chains of thought, and sampling many chains per problem and taking a majority vote raises accuracy at a large cost in generated text. A popular way to cut that cost scores each chain by the model's confidence in each token it writes, where a token is a word or part of a word. The method averages this confidence over a sliding window of 2048 tokens and keeps or stops chains based on the lowest average. We treat the confidence, recorded token by token, as a signal in the sense of audio or radio, and examine the method with standard signal-processing tools such as spectral analysis and statistical tests for detecting a sudden change. We sampled 16 chains for each of 500 problems from two math benchmarks with a small open reasoning model. The windowed-minimum score turns out to measure mostly how long a chain is. Ranking chains by length alone does as well as or better than the confidence score, and once length is accounted for the score carries no information about correctness. entries.title_zh: token 置信度是否只是推理链长度的替身？
entries.summary_zh: 作者对两套数学基准上 500 道题、每题 16 条推理链做信号处理分析，检验用滑窗 token 置信度筛选答案链的方法。结果显示滑窗最低置信度主要反映链长，单用链长表现相当或更好；控制链长后，置信度分数对正确性不再提供信息，原因与对缓慢漂移信号取长窗口最小值的统计效应有关。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提醒推理采样和 verifier 设计者检查简单混杂变量。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对多条思维链投票成本高，筛选指标必须证明超越长度信号。
entries.cynic_review: 用可复现实验指出常用置信指标的长度偏差。
entries.paper_review: 实验使用小型开源模型及特定基准，尚不能概括所有模型。

entries.source_title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
entries.source_excerpt: 慕尼黑地区法院 I 五月底裁定 Google 的 AI 搜索摘要属于公司自己的陈述而非中立转述，Google 须为错误内容担责；Google 公开宣布上诉后实际以和解结案，未获上级法院裁决。
entries.title_zh: 德国法院开始将 Google AI 搜索回答视为 Google 自己的陈述
entries.summary_zh: 文章称，慕尼黑地区法院 I 曾认定 Google 的 AI 搜索摘要属于 Google 自己生成的实质性陈述，不能仅以中立链接中介免责；该案后来以和解结束，没有上级法院对理由作出裁决。亚琛地区法院 9 月的一项尚可被挑战的临时禁令，则针对 AI Mode 把他人的刑事指控错误归到一名医生名下，并援引慕尼黑案的思路，禁止继续传播相关说法。报道讨论的是德国个案中生成式搜索的责任边界，不能视为已确立的终审规则。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合了解生成式搜索错误信息、名誉侵权与平台责任如何在个案中交汇。
entries.pragmatic_review: 产品团队应重视来源核对、纠错响应和高风险人物信息的处理。
entries.cynic_review: 一案和解、另一案未终审，报道呈现的是正在形成的法律论证。
entries.paper_review: 摘要中的关键证据是法院决定及其法律推理，尚缺更高法院的统一解释。

entries.source_title: MS-TTRL: Breaking the Frequency Conflict in Multiple-Solution Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Scientific, engineering, and mathematical reasoning tasks can admit multiple valid solutions, while exhaustive annotation of the full solution set is often prohibitively costly. Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) applies reinforcement learning to unlabeled test instances, offering a label-free approach to multiple-solution reasoning. In this setting, generation frequency serves two opposing objectives: correctness estimation favors frequent outcomes, whereas outcome-level diversity preservation favors less frequent outcomes. We term this tension the \textbf{Frequency Conflict}. To resolve this conflict, we propose MS-TTRL, which obtains frequency-independent correctness estimates through Outcome-Level Self-Verification while reserving generation frequency solely for diversity preservation. Three-State Outcome Cache and the Candidate State support verification reuse across repeated observations and confidence-aware handling of ambiguous outcomes, while Confidence-Gated Inverse Probability Scaling selectively strengthens the learning signals of rare, reliably verified outcomes. entries.title_zh: MS-TTRL：解决多解测试时强化学习的频率冲突
entries.summary_zh: 多解任务中，生成频率既被用来估计答案正确性，也被用来保留输出多样性，两者会冲突。MS-TTRL 用结果级自验证估计正确性、把频率仅用于多样性，并用三态缓存复用验证、对可靠稀有解做置信度门控加权；摘要未提供最终数值增益。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合无标签数学/科学任务中存在多个正确解的测试时学习。
entries.pragmatic_review: 测试时 RL 在测试样本上优化，但常没有人工标准答案。
entries.cynic_review: 将正确性估计与多样性估计分离，针对冲突源设计。
entries.paper_review: 摘要缺少基准成绩和验证开销，无法评估收益幅度。

entries.source_title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. entries.title_zh: CME-SpectrumBench：LLM 能分析凝聚态光谱数据吗？
entries.summary_zh: 作者发布含 190 个专家设计问题的基准，用模拟的凝聚态实验二维光谱强度数据测试模型在噪声、分辨率受限时识别结构和计算数值的能力。论文报告直接询问 LLM 通常明显弱于手写代码：模型能找简单特征，却难以追踪图样或计算派生量，性能还会随噪声及卷积增强而下降。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合科学基础模型评测及实验数据分析研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 将评测从理论问答推进到研究级数值光谱分析。
entries.cynic_review: 基准使用模拟数据，真实仪器与实验室工作流的外推性待验证。
entries.paper_review: 任务规模、数据类型和主要失败模式交代清楚。

entries.source_title: GKZ Systems and Gauss-Manin Connections of Families of Projective Hypersurfaces
entries.source_excerpt: Periods of projective hypersurfaces satisfy GKZ hypergeometric systems, which may have solutions that do not arise as periods. For deformations of Fermat hypersurfaces, we describe the Gauss-Manin connection in terms of images of contiguity operators between GKZ systems. These images are also realized as Fourier transforms of minimal extensions of Kummer modules.
entries.title_zh: 射影超曲面族的 GKZ 系统与 Gauss–Manin 联络
entries.summary_zh: 射影超曲面的周期满足 GKZ 超几何系统，但该系统也可能有非周期解。对 Fermat 超曲面形变，作者用 GKZ 系统间 contiguous 算子的像描述 Gauss–Manin 联络，并把这些像实现为 Kummer 模的最小延拓的 Fourier 变换。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合周期积分、D 模块和超几何系统研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: Gauss–Manin 联络描述代数簇族变化时上同调/周期如何变化。
entries.cynic_review: 聚焦 GKZ 解空间中过多解与真实周期之间的联系。
entries.paper_review: 摘要未给算子公式与具体维数结果。

entries.source_title: Progress on Borsuk’s Problem and Answer to TYI 60.
entries.source_excerpt: The Finite and the Infinite Borsuk problem TYI(60) The question Let f(d) be the smallest integer so that every set of diameter one in can be covered by f(d) sets of smaller diameter. Let g(d) be the smallest integer so … Continue reading →
entries.title_zh: Borsuk 问题进展与 TYI 第 60 题答复
entries.summary_zh: 文章区分 Borsuk 问题的两个量：f(d) 对所有直径为 1 的集合求最少较小直径覆盖数，g(d) 只对有限集合求此数，因此 g(d)≤f(d)。作者讨论“有限集合是否总能达到同样值”的未知问题，并提出对大维度可能严格小于的个人猜想，提醒读者若干声称证明相等的论证曾有错误；这部分明确属于猜想与问题讨论，不是定理结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 澄清有限与一般集合版本的区别，并呈现一个容易被误证的开放问题。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合几何组合学读者理解相关猜想的不同量词范围。
entries.cynic_review: 作者明确表示答案未知，不能把直觉当作进展定理。
entries.paper_review: 文章价值在于问题辨析和研究直觉，而非新证明。

entries.source_title: Bowen--Franks groups and minus class groups of imaginary abelian fields
entries.source_excerpt: $\mathrm{Lei}$, $\mathrm{M\ddot{u}ller}$, and $\mathrm{Valli\grave{e}res}$ constructed a directed graph for which the torsion part of the corresponding Bowen--Franks group is related to the minus part of the class group of a cyclotomic number field with prime conductor. We extend this result to a general imaginary abelian field.
entries.title_zh: Bowen–Franks 群与虚阿贝尔域的负类群

entries.source_title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
entries.source_excerpt: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. This decomposition yields a principled scoring rule to rank token-level guidance. We combine this with a progressive \textbf{coverage annea

entries.source_title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
entries.source_excerpt: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. entries.source_title: Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems
entries.source_excerpt: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. The G-layer enforces geometric quality assurance (GQA) via a mapping f: Theta -> Q from the statistical parameter space to a physically interpretable quality domain, employing a cosine similarity gate to retain minority updates based on physical geometry rather than statistical proximity. The T-layer executes topological Pareto control, identifying a sensitivity-based knee point (lambda_k) to balance multi-objective aggregation without majority degradation. entries.source_title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
entries.source_excerpt: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.

entries.source_title: On the classification of threefold flops
entries.source_excerpt: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities. The key new input is to show that derived localisation at a Hochschild class is Morita invariant; this result raises some interesting questions related to the classification of recollements. We also show that derived contraction algebras admit a deformation-theoretic interpretation in families in a general setting that encompasses threefold flops, flips, and divisor-to-curve contractions.
entries.title_zh: 三维 flop 的分类
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明可能奇异的三维 flopping contraction 可由其导出 contraction algebra 在导出 Morita 等价意义下完全分类；相较光滑情形，一般必须保留额外导出结构。关键输入是证明对 Hochschild 类作导出局部化具有 Morita 不变性；作者还给出导出 contraction algebra 在包括 flop、flip 和 divisor-to-curve 收缩的族中的变形论解释。

entries.source_title: Deflation-Based Spectral Preconditioning for the Conjugate Gradient Method on Perturbed Systems
entries.source_excerpt: We consider sequences of large symmetric positive-definite linear systems in which spectral information from a reference matrix $A$ is reused to accelerate the solution of a nearby system with perturbed matrix $A(t)=A+tE$, where $E$ is symmetric, $\|E\|_F=1$, and $t\geq0$ is the perturbation size. We compare deflated conjugate gradient (deflated CG) with preconditioned CG (PCG) equipped with a scaled spectral preconditioner constructed from the same spectral information of $A$. First, we derive an energy-norm error characterization of deflated CG. We then use perturbation analysis to show that, after one additional PCG iteration, the squared PCG error is bounded, up to terms of order $t^2$, by an explicit multiple of the squared deflated CG error. This result clarifies the role of the scaling parameter in the preconditioner. Experiments show that the scaled spectral preconditioner recovers much of the convergence improvement provided by deflation while requiring fewer products with $A(t)$.
entries.title_zh: 扰动系统共轭梯度法的谱预条件
entries.summary_zh: 论文考虑对称正定矩阵 A 的已知谱信息如何复用于邻近扰动系统 A(t)=A+tE，并比较谱消元共轭梯度与采用缩放谱预条件器的 PCG。作者刻画 deflated CG 的能量范数误差，再证明在额外一次 PCG 迭代后，其平方误差在二阶扰动项之外可由 deflated CG 误差的显式倍数控制；实验表明缩放预条件器能恢复大部分消元带来的收敛改进，同时减少对扰动矩阵的乘法调用。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出复用参考谱信息加速近邻线性系统的误差比较，并解释预条件缩放参数的作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合参数扫描或重复求解相近大型正定线性系统。

entries.source_title: Non-local to local limit for stochastic conservation laws
entries.source_excerpt: This work proves the convergence of stochastic nonlocal conservation laws, with spatially inhomogeneous noise, to stochastic conservation laws when the range of particle interaction vanishes. This provides rigorous justification for a class of stochastic conservation laws that has received considerable attention in the last decade. To handle technical challenges such as gradient-dependent noise, modified versions of the equations with specific cutoff boundaries are utilized and new uniform estimates to ensure stability during the limiting process are established. In addition, the work demonstrates that this convergence depends on the presence of a viscous term, as a counterexample shows that without it, the limiting solution may fail to be an entropy solution.
entries.title_zh: 随机守恒律的非局部到局部极限
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明空间非齐次噪声下，随机非局部守恒律在粒子交互范围趋零时收敛到随机局部守恒律，为一类常用模型提供严格极限依据。证明引入带特定截断边界的近似方程并建立一致估计；同时给出反例说明黏性项不可缺少，否则极限可能不是熵解。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合随机 PDE、守恒律和非局部模型极限研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 熵解是在弱解不唯一时满足物理熵条件的解。

entries.source_title: No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints
entries.source_excerpt: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.
entries.title_zh: 库存约束下序贯做市的无悔收益最大化
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究买卖双方估值未知时，做市商如何在 T 轮交易中最大化收益并控制库存风险。仅观察交易成败时，算法的 regret 与库存界为 T^(2/3) 量级；失败订单也能看到完整订单簿时可改进至 √T，并证明更紧的逐轮库存限制必然带来更大的最小 regret。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合在线市场机制与算法交易研究者理解信息可见性和风险约束的代价。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把库存限制与收益 regret 的基本权衡刻画出来。
entries.cynic_review: 理论设定为价格阈值型独立交易，实际市场机制更复杂。
entries.paper_review: 分别给出两种反馈条件下的上界和下界权衡。

entries.source_title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
entries.source_excerpt: As AI systems begin to resolve open research problems, reliable verification becomes increasingly important. Formal mathematics provides a trusted framework for mathematical reasoning, enabling agents to produce machine-checkable proofs while conducting mathematical exploration. Existing formal mathematics benchmarks often focus on known results or a small set of prominent open problems, which can become difficult to evaluate reliably once solutions are discovered and widely disseminated. Existing evaluation protocols are also not always aligned with how modern coding agents operate. We therefore introduce ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), spanning entry-level open research problems across a broad range of mathematical subfields. We expect these less prominent open problems, which tend to attract less attention and may remain unsolved for longer, to be better suited for held-out evaluation of end-to-end open problem resolution in Lean. We adopt a standard coding-agent evaluation setting, placing each problem and its logical negation into a Lean project
entries.title_zh: ReuF2F：形式化本科研究问题的编程代理基准
entries.summary_zh: ReuF2F 是一个 Lean 4 基准，包含 244 个来自本科研究体验项目（REU）的形式化开放问题，覆盖多个数学领域的入门级研究问题。它针对传统形式化数学基准偏重已知定理或少量知名猜想、且现代编程代理评测流程不匹配的问题，提供可机器检查证明的研究型任务集合；基准质量仍取决于题目难度和形式化覆盖。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把真实本科研究题转成可验证 Lean 任务，扩展形式化数学代理评测。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于测量 coding agents 在开放式数学形式化中的能力。

entries.source_title: Hybridizable Discontinuous Galerkin methods for the Keller-Segel model
entries.source_excerpt: We propose a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) finite element method to approximate the solution of the time-dependent Keller-Segel model, a drift-diffusion system describing chemotactic cell movement. We develop and analyze the corresponding HDG scheme, and establish theoretical convergence results for the proposed discretization. Finally, we present numerical experiments that confirm the theoretical findings.

entries.source_title: The Projective Reed-Muller Code from Quartic Curves in the Projective Plane
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Hamming weight enumerator of the projective Reed-Muller code $\mathcal C_{2,4}$ over $\mathbf F_q$, with $\operatorname{char}(\mathbf F_q)>3$. We determine the geometrically reducible and singular contributions by combining incidence counts with counts of plane linear series on a fixed normalization. The line and conic configurations and the genus zero cases give explicit polynomials. The line-cubic and genus one cases give formulas involving class numbers. The genus two contribution is a finite sum over hyperelliptic models, using their point counts over $\mathbf F_q$ and $\mathbf F_{q^2}$ and their rational Weierstrass points. The remaining smooth contribution is the weighted point count distribution of nonhyperelliptic genus three curves.

entries.source_title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. entries.source_title: Local obstructions and certified computations for perfect powers in power sums
entries.source_excerpt: Let $S_k(x)=1^k+\cdots+x^k$. We study perfect-power values of $S_k(x)$ by combining local valuations with finite congruence certificates. For an irregular Bernoulli pair $(p,r)$ with $e=v_p(B_r)\ge1$, we prove a valuation formula uniform for $k\equiv r+1\pmod{p^e(p-1)}$, subject to an explicit condition on $v_p(x(x+1))$. This gives explicit families of nonexistence results in which both $x$ and $k$ are unbounded. We also determine all solutions of $S_k(x)=y^n$ for $3\le x\le10^6$ with $x\equiv0,3\pmod4$, leaving $k$ and $n\ge2$ unrestricted and including squares. This extends Hajdu's fixed-$x$ classification in the same residue classes. A uniform restriction on the normalized odd part of $S_k(x)$ and finite certificates exclude every $k\ge6$; the remaining exponents are checked by exact integer arithmetic. The certificates admit independent verification. We further prove a limitation of congruence tests of bounded prime-power depth and solve the equation for every $x\equiv28\pmod{5\,110\,664}$.
entries.title_zh: 幂和完全幂的局部障碍与可认证计算

entries.source_title: Codimension of Brill-Noether Loci on Abelian Surfaces and the First Segre Invariant
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X$ be an abelian surface of Picard rank 1 with ample generator $H$. We show that, for a Mukai vector $\mathbf{v}=(r,mH,\chi)$ with $r,m\geq 1$ and $\chi\leq 0$, the first Brill-Noether loci $\{E \;|\; H^0(E)\neq 0\}$ in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$ is nonempty of the expected codimension $1-\chi$. As an application, we study the rank 1 Segre invariant on these abelian surfaces. Specifically, for $\mathbf{v}$ a Mukai vector of a $\mu$-stable sheaf of $\mathrm{rank}\geq 2$, we compute the Segre invariant of the general sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$, and we determine the numbers which arise as the Segre invariant of a sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$.
entries.title_zh: 阿贝尔曲面上 Brill–Noether 轨迹的余维与首个 Segre 不变量
entries.summary_zh: 对 Picard 秩 1 的阿贝尔曲面及满足指定条件的 Mukai 向量，作者证明稳定层模空间中拥有非零截面的首个 Brill–Noether 轨迹非空且余维为预期值 1−χ。进一步计算一般层的秩一 Segre 不变量，并确定模空间中层可实现的 Segre 数值。

entries.source_title: LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation
entries.source_excerpt: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. entries.source_title: A note on the Besov spaces ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$
entries.source_excerpt: Regarding the Besov space ${\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2}$, defined by S. Geiss and Ylinen (Memoirs AMS 1335, 2021) by a coupling method, we prove for $\xi\in{\rm B}_1^{\Phi_2} \cap L_2$ a distributional estimate in terms of the Lorentz-Zygmund space $L_{1,\infty}(\ln L)^{-1}$ for the Malliavin derivative ${\rm D}(T_u\xi)$ uniformly in $u>0$, where $(T_u)_{u\ge }$ is the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semi-group. Here $\xi$ is not necessarily Malliavin differentiable in the ${\rm D}_{1,1}$-sense. This provides for Theorem 4.22 of the aforementioned reference an extension to the borderline case $p=1$.
entries.title_zh: Besov 空间 B₁^{Φ₂} 的一个端点估计

entries.source_title: Germwise singular Fourier--Mukai partnerships
entries.source_excerpt: We study how local behavior on the base controls whether integral transforms induce fully faithful functors or equivalences between singularity categories of proper flat families. By working with \'{e}tale germs, we show (under mild hypotheses) that the loci where this happens are open and are compatible with \'{e}tale base change. Moreover, we give examples, exhibit an autoequivalence of the singularity category which detects regularity of the base, and compute these loci for arithmetic families.

entries.source_title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematical modelling of burn injury healing involves coupling biological processes with mechanical deformation, resulting in computationally stiff, nonlinear partial differential equations that severely limit the scalability of existing numerical solutions. We present a computational framework addressing these challenges. By nondimensionalizing the model and performing scaling analysis, we show that chemotaxis and inertia are negligible, permitting a quasi-static momentum approach. To enforce non-negativity constraints, we implement a Variational Inequality formulation using the Finite Element Method in FEniCSx, and verify it via numerical convergence studies and mass balances. We identify high-order parameter interactions, specifically equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics, as the primary drivers of solver stability. A sensitivity analysis of nearly four million simulations reveals that isolated parameter variations predominantly govern the maximum wound contraction. entries.source_title: A functional central limit theorem for the KPZ equation with narrow wedge initial data
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we consider the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) equation with narrow wedge initial data. We prove a functional central limit theorem for the spatial average of the solution, which solves an open problem from Gu and Pu (2025). Our main tool is Clark-Ocone formula from Malliavin calculus, combined with an in-depth analysis of the increments of the solution. The main step is a moment bound for time increments of the normalized spatial integral. For this, we introduce a new technique, called a ``common-ray'' change of variables. Using the fact that Malliavin derivative of the solution satisfies a Chapman-Kolmogorov relation, we reduce the kernel differences at two times to spatial increments at one common time.
entries.title_zh: 窄楔初值 KPZ 方程的函数中心极限定理

entries.source_title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
entries.source_excerpt: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. entries.source_title: Explicit strong blocking sets and minimal codes from expander graphs using a new graph parameter
entries.source_excerpt: A strong blocking set is a set of points in a finite projective space that intersects every hyperplane of the space in a spanning set of the hyperplane. These objects have been studied both in finite geometry and coding theory due to their equivalence with minimal codes. We give an explicit construction of strong blocking sets using expander graphs that improves the explicit construction of Alon et al. (Noga Alon, Anurag Bishnoi, Shagnik Das, Alessandro Neri, Strong blocking sets and minimal codes from expander graphs. Transactions of the American Mathematical Society ) by introducing a new geometrically motivated graph parameter that is better suited for this problem. Using this approach, we improve the constant $C$ in the explicit construction of a strong blocking set of size $C (q+1) k$ in the $(k - 1)$-dimensional projective space over $\mathbb{F}_q$ for every prime power $q \geq 7$.
entries.title_zh: 利用扩展图构造强阻塞集与极小码

entries.source_title: On the existence of mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors
entries.source_excerpt: Orthogonal arrays are foundational objects in combinatorial design theory and experimental design theory, with broad applications in computer science, coding theory, and cryptography. In this paper, we investigate the existence for mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors, and propose several new constructions based on incomplete orthogonal Latin squares, incomplete transversal designs, and $\Sigma$-resolvable transversal designs. As a result, we show that the necessary conditions for the existence of such mixed orthogonal arrays are also sufficient, except for a small number of known exceptions and nine unsettled cases.

entries.source_title: Elementary Moves on Ideal Webs, Local Monodromies on Hitchin Fibrations, and Tropical Mutations on $\mathrm{K_0}$ Groups
entries.source_excerpt: This paper builds on the work of Goncharov by studying the correspondence between topological spectral covers constructed from generic $A_{m-1}$-webs with rank $m\ge2$, Hitchin spectral curves over good Hitchin loci, and the Grothendieck groups $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma})$ associated with the quivers with potential $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$ assigned to corresponding bipartite $A_{m-1}$-graphs. We show that the automorphisms on the non-frozen quiver lattices $\Lambda_{\Gamma}^{\circ}$ induced by compositions of elementary moves on ideal webs/bipartite graphs are the same as the Gauss--Manin monodromy actions on the $SL_m$ Hitchin fiber lattices $H_1(\operatorname{Prym}(\Sigma);\mathbb{Z})$ locally around discriminant loci. And the Gauss--Manin monodromy actions agree with the automorphisms on the Grothendieck groups $K_0(\mathcal{D}_{\Gamma}^{\circ})$ induced by compositions of mutations on the quivers with potential $(Q_{\Gamma},W_{\Gamma})$.
entries.title_zh: 理想网的基本变换、Hitchin 单值与 K₀ 群变异
entries.summary_zh: 论文比较三种结构：理想 A_{m−1} 网给出的拓扑谱覆盖、Hitchin 纤维曲线，以及带势箭图的范畴 K₀ 群。作者证明基本变换诱导的非冻结箭图格自同构，与判别子附近 Hitchin 纤维的 Gauss–Manin 单值作用一致，也等于 quiver mutation 在 K₀ 上诱导的变换。

entries.source_title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
entries.source_excerpt: Symantec 研究人员通过蜜罐截获一个把大语言模型嵌入核心的攻击智能体，它会劫持互联网上无防护的模型端点，自主扫描目标、利用服务器漏洞、窃取数据库凭据并安装挖矿程序，最多连续执行 100,000 步，算力费用由被劫持模型的主人承担。
entries.title_zh: 恶意智能体劫持未受保护的大模型发起持续攻击
entries.summary_zh: The Decoder 转述 Symantec 蜜罐捕获的攻击提示词：操作者试图劫持暴露在互联网上的模型端点，让模型规划扫描、利用漏洞、窃取凭据和部署挖矿程序，并设计了最多 10 万步的循环流程。报道指出提示词使用多层越狱，并含 74 个攻击模块，但蜜罐没有执行这些工具，分析也未证明越狱能稳定绕过商业模型防护；主要风险是暴露模型端点被盗用并产生算力账单和下游攻击。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 提醒组织保护未认证模型 API、密钥和工具权限，并将报道中的观察与已执行攻击区分。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应检查模型网关鉴权、速率限制、密钥轮换和工具隔离。
entries.cynic_review: 捕获到攻击提示词不等于完整攻击链已成功运行。
entries.paper_review: 展示了模型劫持与自主工具链组合的威胁模型。

entries.source_title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model

entries.source_title: Robust topology optimization of isogeometric Kirchhoff--Love shells by the Speed Method
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents a framework for robust topology optimization of Kirchhoff-Love (KL) multi-patch shells using isogeometric analysis and non-matching meshes and provides a CAD-compatible method. The material distribution is optimized via a NURBS-based level set method, enabling accurate boundary representation and seamless export to standard CAD/CAM workflows. The shape derivative is computed using the speed method, yielding a volume-based formulation that avoids boundary approximations and aligns with the isogeometric principle of coarse, high-order discretizations. This eliminates the need for local refinement, adaptive quadrature, or trimming as the descent direction for the compliance and volume objectives are obtained through a biharmonic equation. The framework is extended to robust optimization under uncertainty, accounting for stochastic loading and material properties via Monte Carlo sampling and Gaussian Random Fields. Numerical examples demonstrate the method's efficiency and robustness across single- and multi-patch shells, reproducing literature results with fewer elements than traditional FEM or refined IGA approaches.

entries.source_title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. entries.source_title: MHeatmap: Two-Walk Laplacian Reordering and Mosaic Layout for Rectangular Matrix Visualization
entries.source_excerpt: Weighted rectangular matrices record relations between two types of objects, such as occupations and industries, documents and terms, origins and destinations, or annotated classes and computed clusters. Their heatmaps become difficult to read when arbitrary row and column orders scatter related objects, while equal size cells hide large differences in row and column totals. We present MHeatmap (Mosaic Heatmap), which addresses these problems in two stages. Two-Walk spectral seriation first represents the matrix as a weighted bipartite graph. Ordinary bipartite ordering uses only observed row to column links. Two-Walk also uses length-two walks, so rows that share columns and columns that share rows receive explicit similarity links. Sorting a Fiedler vector of the resulting graph Laplacian gives coordinated row and column orders. The Mosaic layout then partitions a unit square so that row height is proportional to the row total and column width is proportional to the column total, while color represents the observed entry. entries.source_title: Hypercube Richardson varieties from magic words
entries.source_excerpt: Inspired by the recent preprint of Ellenberg, Libedinsky, Plaza, Simental, and Williamson, we study the geometry of Richardson varieties whose associated Bruhat intervals are boolean posets. We define magic words for a Bruhat interval and prove that for intervals with magic words the associated Richardson variety is a tower of $\mathbb{P}^1$-s. We also prove that the Bruhat intervals consisting of the dyadically well-distributed permutations all have magic words. This gives a new proof that they form a boolean poset.
entries.title_zh: 由 magic words 构造超立方 Richardson 簇
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 Bruhat 区间为布尔偏序时对应的 Richardson 簇几何，并为含有“magic word”的区间证明其簇是由若干个 P¹ 依次构成的塔。作者还证明，坐标分布具有 dyadic 均匀性的置换所对应的 Bruhat 区间都存在 magic word，从而给出这些区间为布尔偏序的一个新证明。

entries.source_title: $a$-numbers of covers in characteristic two: semigroups and Riemann-Roch spaces
entries.source_excerpt: We compute the $a$-numbers of the Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth curves, the Beelen-Montanucci curves, and the Skabelund covers of Suzuki curves in characteristic two. The proofs use the identity $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ and reduce the calculations to Riemann-Roch spaces on the base curves. We obtain transfer formulas for odd-degree radical covers, with one or several points at infinity, and evaluate them using Weierstrass semigroups and plane sections of the Hermitian curve. For the first two families we also give cyclic models over the projective line and relate the formulas to Elkin's rank formula. We then treat two classes of Artin-Schreier fibre products. A supersingular genus-six family has a-number $3$ at the zero parameter and $2$ elsewhere, although the genera and $a$-numbers of its quadratic quotients remain fixed. We determine its Ekedahl--Oort types as $(0,0,0,1,2,3)$ and $(0,1,1,2,3,4)$,
entries.title_zh: 特征二覆盖曲线的 a 数：半群与 Riemann–Roch 空间
entries.summary_zh: 论文计算若干特征二代数曲线覆盖（包括 Garcia–Güneri–Stichtenoth、Beelen–Montanucci 与 Suzuki 曲线的 Skabelund 覆盖）的 a 数，并把计算化为基曲线上的 Riemann–Roch 空间维数，再用 Weierstrass 半群和 Hermitian 曲线截面求值。一个超奇异亏格六族的 a 数在零参数时为 3、其他参数时为 2，尽管其二次商的亏格和 a 数保持不变；作者还给出对应 Ekedahl–Oort 类型。

entries.source_title: Analysis and approximation for inverse potential problem of space-dependent variable-exponent sub-diffusion in heterogeneous medium
entries.source_excerpt: Anomalous transport in complex heterogeneous medium is often characterized by non-Markovian memory effects and spatially varying trapping properties. From the point of view of continuous-time random walks, such heterogeneity can be described by a position-dependent heavy-tailed waiting-time density $q(t \mid x)\sim C(x)t^{-1-\alpha(x)}$, where $0<\alpha(x)<1$ is the local anomalous exponent. This microscopic interpretation naturally leads to the sub-diffusion with a space-dependent variable exponent $\alpha(x)$. Compared with constant-exponent models, the variable-exponent fractional operators generally do not commute with the spatial Laplacian, which makes both the forward and inverse analysis substantially more delicate. This paper investigates the inverse problem of recovering a spatially dependent radiative or potential coefficient in variable-exponent sub-diffusion from terminal observation data. We formulate the inverse problem as a nonlinear fixed-point equation and prove that the associated fixed-point operator is monotone such that the fixed-point iteration converges decreasingly to the unique solution. entries.summary_zh: 论文研究从终端观测恢复空间依赖势/辐射系数的变指数次扩散反问题；由于分数阶算子与空间 Laplacian 一般不交换，变系数情形比常阶模型更复杂。作者将其写成非线性不动点方程，并证明算子单调，使迭代单调递减收敛到唯一解；所给摘录在后续误差分析结果前截断。

entries.source_title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
entries.source_excerpt: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe m
entries.title_zh: Watermark Basins：黑盒检测蒸馏语言模型
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出 token 级水印在低温度蒸馏等情况下可能难以检测，并提出参数空间中的“水印盆地”：带水印教师轨迹微调后会留下与任务微调子空间近似正交且与密钥相关的几何信号。WM-Basin 只通过 API 查询可疑模型并将文本映射到梯度表征来检测，无需访问权重或 logits；摘要中的细节尚未覆盖完整实验表现。

project_insight.translation_zh: 一个面向编程智能体的 Skill，可将智能体组织成多阶段安全审计流程，并输出经过独立核验的机器可读发现。流程包括：侦察并记录架构与覆盖范围；按覆盖清单分配搜寻任务并检查遗漏；让新的验证者尝试推翻候选问题；将结果写入 findings.json 并按 Schema 校验；由独立智能体核验最终记录中的源码依据；最后根据已验证记录和覆盖台账生成报告。发现分为 confirmed、needs_validation 和 rejected。项目要求使用支持工具调用和并行子 Agent 的编程智能体、Node.js 验证器，以及对目标代码构建与测试进行操作系统级隔离的沙箱；沙箱应禁用外网、使用受限环境并限制资源和写入路径。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 把单仓库安全审计组织为带覆盖台账、候选反证和独立记录核验的 Agent 工作流，并生成结构化发现与报告。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读 SKILL.md、RECONNAISSANCE.md 和 VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md，理解流程与结果判定；检查仓库中的 Schema 和验证器后，再选择隔离良好的测试仓库试运行，并为构建、测试和目标代码准备禁网沙箱。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是 Skill 工作流而非独立安全扫描器，效果依赖编程智能体、子 Agent 和沙箱能力；项目要求操作系统级隔离、禁用外部网络并限制资源。材料未提供审计基准或独立效果评估；GitHub 页面标注 MIT 许可。

entries.source_title: Metric dimension and maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of graph Laplacians
entries.source_excerpt: We study equality between metric dimension and the maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices. These quantities are not ordered in general. Using the standard decomposition associated with twin classes, we separate forced multiplicities from quotient-spectrum contributions. We give complete equality classifications for complete multipartite graphs and core--satellite graphs, and enumerate the multipartite equality graphs by order. For graphs formed by attaching at least two leaves to every vertex of a connected core, the metric dimension and the multiplicity of the eigenvalue $ 1 $ are known; we show that this multiplicity is maximal for both matrices, and uniquely maximal except for $ P_3 $. We enumerate this core--leaf family up to isomorphism and obtain a uniform asymptotic formula by order and metric dimension, together with the quadratic exponential growth rate $ 1/18 $. An exact census of connected graphs of orders two through seven identifies the first separating examples and examples without twins. Finally, for every odd $ r \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 3} $, we study $ \Theta_{2, 2, r} $ and dete
entries.title_zh: 图拉普拉斯的度量维数与最大特征值重数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究图的度量维数与拉普拉斯、符号拉普拉斯矩阵最大特征值重数何时相等。作者借助孪生顶点类分解区分由局部重复结构强制出的重数和商图谱贡献，完整分类完全多部图与核心—卫星图的相等情形，并证明在连通核心每个顶点都附加至少两个叶子的图中，特征值 1 的重数对两种矩阵都是最大且唯一达到。

entries.source_title: Average eccentricity in k-connected tournaments
entries.source_excerpt: The average eccentricity $\avec(D)$ of a strong digraph $D$ is the mean eccentricity of all vertices in $D$. A tournament $T$ is an orientation of a complete graph. In this paper, we prove that the average eccentricity satisfies $2 \le \avec(T) < \frac{n}{2k} + \frac{11}{2} + \frac{k}{8n}$ for a $k$-connected tournament $T$ of order $n$. We further examine the case for strong tournaments where $k = 1$, and show that $\avec(T) \le \frac{n+11}{2} + \frac{1}{8n}$ for any strong tournament $T$. Moreover, we show that the lower bound $2$ is sharp and that the upper bounds are best possible apart from an additive constant.
entries.title_zh: k-连通竞赛图的平均离心率
entries.summary_zh: 对 n 个顶点的 k-连通竞赛图，论文证明平均离心率至少为 2，且严格小于约 n/(2k)+常数量级的上界；k=1 的强连通情形也给出专门上界。下界达到且上界除加法常数外最佳，连接了定向完全图的连通度和顶点最远距离平均值。

entries.pragmatic_review: 竞赛图是完全图每条边选定一个方向；离心率为到最远点的距离。

entries.source_title: Summation-by-parts operators for general function spaces: Flux differencing, entropy stability, and accuracy
entries.source_excerpt: Summation-by-parts (SBP) operators are a cornerstone of provably stable high-order methods for hyperbolic conservation laws. For nonlinear problems, the flux-differencing framework of Fisher and Carpenter combines such SBP operators with entropy-conservative two-point fluxes to obtain semi-discretizations that are conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff and discretely entropy-conservative or stable. So far, this framework has been developed exclusively for operators that are exact for polynomials. Function-space SBP (FSBP) operators lift this restriction by being exact on a general finite-dimensional function space that can be tailored to the problem at hand. In this work, we extend flux differencing to FSBP operators for general (potentially non-polynomial) function spaces. We prove that, whenever the operator has a diagonal norm and its function space contains the constants, the resulting semi-discretization is conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff, semi-discretely entropy-conservative within a single element, and entropy-stable across element interfaces. We also provide the first theoretical accuracy analysis of FSBP operat

entries.source_title: Deep Bayesian Approaches for Interpretable Nonlinear Structural System Identification
entries.source_excerpt: System identification, namely the inference of mathematical representations of dynamical systems from measured data, is fundamental to engineering diagnostics, prognostics, and decision-making. Bayesian filtering offers a principled framework for probabilistic state estimation but traditionally relies on prescribed transition and observation models. Recent advances in deep Bayesian filtering address this limitation by embedding learnable representations within probabilistic state-space formulations, enabling data-driven identification of unknown dynamics while retaining physical structure and uncertainty-aware inference. This tutorial provides a systematic introduction to deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, focusing on the interplay between learned dynamics, physical inductive biases, and posterior inference. The Deep Markov Model serves as a data-driven reference, while the Physics-guided Deep Markov Model (PgDMM) and Neural Extended Kalman Filter (Neural EKF) illustrate complementary approaches based on amortized variational inference and differentiable Kalman filtering, respectively. Their capabi

entries.source_title: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
entries.source_excerpt: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with

entries.source_title: Optimal CLT error bounds in the second order Wasserstein metric via Stein's method for weakly dependent sequences
entries.source_excerpt: We use Stein's method to prove general upper bounds on the second order Wasserstein distance in the CLT for general dependent partial sums $S_N=X_1+\ldots +X_N$. Then we use these estimates to provide optimal $O(N^{-1/2})$ rates for a variety of chaotic dynamical systems and $\phi$- and $\psi$-mixing sequences. Our results for $\psi$-mixing sequences are obtained under the fourth moment condition, which matches the best known results in the iid case. This is the first time that optimal CLT rates of any kind are obtained for unbounded weakly stationary variables under general mixing conditions. We then apply this result and obtain optimal CLT rates $O\left((\text{Var}(S_N))^{-1/2}\right)$ for non-stationary $\psi$-mixing sequences without any growth rates on $\text{Var}(S_N)$. We also obtain close to optimal CLT rates for nonconventional sums and some classes of random dynamical systems with non-uniform decay of correlations

entries.source_title: Thinking Hard Above AI
entries.source_excerpt: There are many ways in which AI is generating uncertainty in mathematics. We are not sure how it will impact our jobs, it is raising questions about how it might affect academic training, and it is not clear how it might change the job search process and how we evaluate research. This is by no means an exhaustive list. In this post, I will focus two another related questions, which are: “Is there still any mathematics to be done? And will doing mathematics still be fun and interesting?” I believe that there is, and here I set out to explain why.

entries.source_title: Strict monotonicity of weighted inhomogeneous percolation thresholds under covering maps
entries.source_excerpt: We study Bernoulli bond percolation under weak covering maps for a class of weighted inhomogeneous product measures such that each edge $e$ carries a positive weight $w(e)$ and is open at intensity $\lambda\geq 0$ with probability $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$. We prove a strict monotonicity of the weighted critical intensities $\lambda_c$ in the covering compatibility setting under bounded degree, uniform ellipticity, tame fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. While for the weighted uniform connection thresholds $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$, we establish their strict monotonicity for non-injective weak covering maps under bounded degree, covering compatibility, uniform ellipticity, bounded-fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. Moreover, we verify a general-profile theorem on strict monotonicities of the two thresholds $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ respectively under explicit compact-interval finite-energy, derivative bounds and aforementioned geometric conditions.

entries.source_title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
entries.source_excerpt: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosick\'y and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model. To achieve this, we define ultraproducts of enriched structures and prove enriched versions of {\L}os' theorem. We then develop some model-theoretic applications. We start with an enriched version of the model-theoretic method of diagrams, establishing a correspondence between homomorphisms whose domain is some enriched structure $A$ and models of the set $\operatorname{Diag}(A)$ of all enriched atomic formulas with parameters from $A$ that are true in $A$. entries.title_zh: 富逻辑的紧致性定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文把正逻辑（相干逻辑）推广到对称幺半闭范畴 V 内部的结构中，函数与关系符号的元数本身可以是 V 的对象，并证明相应紧致性：若一组 V-富化序列的每个有限子集都有内部模型，则整组也有模型。作者通过定义富化结构的超积并证明 Łoś 定理，再发展模型论图式方法，推出若干嵌合结果并奠定富化语法类型的基础；实例包括集合、预层拓扑、幺半群作用、阿贝尔群、富化范畴、偏序与伪度量空间。

entries.source_title: Alp\"oge's counterexample to the JC, Economic Stabilization, and Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30). On the other hand, we will perform degree 3 reduction after all to obtain counterexamples of low degree. We construct counterexamples to JC(12,3), HJC(18,3), VC(34,4), and HVC(36,4). As an encore, we construct a cubic-linear counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture in dimension 90. All presented counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture (Vanishing Conjecture) are over the (Gaussian) integers.

entries.source_title: Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies
entries.source_excerpt: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. The embedding-based taxonomies exhibit substantial but incomplete correspondence with the existing taxonomies, revealing both preserved and alternative

entries.source_title: A sound pure type system with ranks as sorts and Type-in-Type
entries.source_excerpt: We present a dependently typed pure type system that contains a circular axiom $s : s$ for a certain sort $s$ and is nonetheless strongly normalizing. Girard's paradox is avoided because our sorts are not closed under a $\Pi$-former: function types are placed in sorts according to their rank. Turns out that this system has a unique set of characteristics: it has similar normalization behaviour as STLC (so complexity of normalization is TOWER-complete) while at the same time allowing non-uniform representation of arbitrary elementary recursive functions; furthermore, it has a nontrivial set-theoretical model in ZF+GCH and allows to carry out nontrivial proof developments. Base normalization proof is surprisingly simple (modulo general metatheoretical properties of pure type systems) and has been fully formalized in vanilla Rocq (formerly Coq) without additional axioms.
entries.title_zh: 以 rank 为 sort 且含 Type-in-Type 的可靠纯类型系统

entries.source_title: Automorphisms and Hodge isometries of surfaces with $K^2=p_g=1$
entries.source_excerpt: Let $S$ be a minimal complex surface of general type with $K_S^2=p_g(S)=1$. By a theorem of Catanese, the canonical model of $S$ is a complete intersection of two sextics in $\mathbf{P}(1,2,2,3,3)$ whose equations admit a normal form, and the global Torelli theorem fails for these surfaces. We describe $\operatorname{Aut}(S)$ in terms of the coefficients of the normal form, prove that $|\operatorname{Aut}(S)|\leq 72$, and classify the surfaces attaining the bound: two surfaces with singular canonical model and a one-parameter family $X_r$ of smooth surfaces. For the surfaces $X_r$ we compute a basis of the primitive cohomology consisting of eigenvectors of a subgroup $\mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z} \times \mathbf{Z}/6\mathbf{Z}$ of $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$, given by residues of explicit polynomials, together with the intersection form in this basis. We then show that the natural map from $\operatorname{Aut}(X_r)$ to the group of Hodge isometries of the primitive lattice modulo $\pm1$ is injective but has image of index at least $331\,776$, so that the Torelli principle for automorphisms fails for these surfaces.
entries.title_zh: K²=p_g=1 曲面的自同构与 Hodge 等距
entries.summary_zh: 对 K_S²=p_g(S)=1 的极小一般型复曲面，作者用规范模型系数描述 Aut(S)，证明自同构群阶不超过 72 并分类取等对象。对一参数光滑曲面族，进一步显式构造本原上同调格的特征向量基与交叉形式，并发现自然映射到 Hodge 等距群模 ±1 后像的指数至少 331,776，说明这些曲面上的 Torelli 型自同构原则失败。
