entries.title_zh: Diamond 极大算子的分类、模空间与振荡包络
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究由有限维实赋范空间值的有界消去核生成的 Euclidean 与非阿基米德球上极大平均算子，并刻画算子间逐点支配关系。角向核的支配可等价转为角平均映射分解，有限分割情形由对称凸体、Grassmannian 或半正定 Gram 矩阵分类；一般核则由所有尺度平均密度与对偶单位球生成的闭凸包作完全不变量。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合调和分析与局部域分析读者关注极大算子之间何时等价或支配。
entries.pragmatic_review: 给出多类核函数下的分类不变量和结构化参数空间。
entries.cynic_review: 结果依赖有限维值域、核类别及文中定义，技术适用范围较专门。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明了标量、向量和一般核的不同分类框架。

entries.source_title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons.
entries.title_zh: MemCryst：记忆与技能双向进化的终身上下文适配
entries.summary_zh: MemCryst 让冻结语言模型在交互历史中共同更新外部记忆和可复用技能：重复经验推动技能生成/修订，技能指导的新交互再补充记忆；任务结果会调整未来检索权重，但不改写存储事实。论文在具身控制、长文理解、对话、数学和代码等十种设置中，报告七项比较领先，强调在有限上下文窗口下积累可迁移经验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合构建长期运行且上下文有限的工具代理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 记忆回答“发生过什么”，技能表达“如何做”，二者互相影响。
entries.cynic_review: 明确分离事实存储、技能程序与检索权重。
entries.paper_review: 摘要未给提升数值，记忆错误和技能漂移仍须治理。

entries.source_title: Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. entries.title_zh: Evolution Strategy RL：用进化策略做持续测试时学习
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 ESRL，在无外部监督的持续测试时适应中，不再只用当前单一策略产生自监督信号，而是扰动锚点策略形成一组邻近策略，各自产生轨迹，再汇总为无标签组相对学习信号。该设计意在降低策略自身漂移导致监督信号同步漂移、最终崩溃或遗忘的风险；当前摘录未给具体基准增益。

entries.pragmatic_review: 用策略群体而非单模型自评来减轻自我强化偏差。
entries.cynic_review: 群体采样会增加推理成本，实际稳定性收益需看完整实验。
entries.paper_review: 动机与方法明确，量化结果未在摘录出现。

entries.source_title: Complete regular dessins: the nonmetacyclic case
entries.source_excerpt: We classify regular dessins on $K_{2^e,2^f}$ with nonmetacyclic colour-preserving automorphism group, retaining the two specified vertex rotations. We give nonredundant presentations and exact counts in both the abelian and nonabelian Frattini cases. For orientation- and colour-preserving isomorphisms, the number is $2^{2e-2}+16$ when $e=f\ge4$ and $3\cdot2^{2f-3}+16$ when $e>f\ge4$, with explicit counts for all smaller exponents. The construction uses a parity criterion in the abelian case and a uniquely determined odd quadratic root with two lifts in the nonabelian case. A dessin in the classification is reflexible exactly when its Frattini subgroup is abelian. All symmetric classes are circular. We determine every circular subfamily, including its face orders and genera; the circular count is $2^e+8$ on the diagonal and $2^{f-2}(2^{f-1}+1)+8$ off the diagonal for $e\ge f\ge4$.
entries.title_zh: 完全正则 dessins 的非亚循环情形
entries.summary_zh: 论文分类嵌入完全二部图 K_{2^e,2^f} 的正则 dessins，限制为保持颜色的自同构群非亚循环，并保留指定的两个顶点旋转；分别在 Frattini 子群为阿贝尔和非阿贝尔时给出无冗余表示与精确计数。对于 e=f≥4，取向与颜色保持的同构类数为 2^(2e−2)+16；e>f≥4 时为 3·2^(2f−3)+16，较小指数另有显式计数；作者还刻画可反射性与 Frattini 子群阿贝尔性的等价关系，并分类对称类中的圆形子族及其面阶、亏格。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数组合与曲面拓扑读者，提供特定二幂阶完全二部图嵌入的群论分类和计数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 精确计数有助于构造和比较相关图嵌入族。
entries.cynic_review: 结论范围受图型、指数下界和自同构群条件严格限制。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明分类分支及计数公式，术语和旋转约定需读论文确认。

entries.source_title: Solving Go under Positional Superko: Sound Proof Transfer and New Board Values
entries.source_excerpt: Positional superko (PSK) forbids recreating any earlier whole-board position. It is part of the Chinese rules as written and of the rules used in computer Go. Yet almost all solved Go boards were computed under a simpler basic-ko rule set. PSK makes solving hard: legality depends on the whole game history, and this breaks the three tools that make solving tractable, namely transposition tables (the graph-history interaction problem), static life-and-death recognition, and safe move pruning. We present Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver that restores all three soundly. Its core is a cheap proof-transfer theorem: a stored proof stays valid on a new path unless a board that the proof's winner must create has already occurred. Sanko proves 5x5 Go in 16 minutes with six threads, where the previous state of the art needed 5.25 hours with six processes, and in about a minute and a half on one 192-thread machine. It also establishes the first PSK values of twenty-three further boards, eleven of which were unsolved under any rules. entries.title_zh: 在位置超级劫持规则下求解围棋
entries.summary_zh: 位置超级劫持（PSK）禁止棋盘整体局面重复，使合法性依赖完整棋史，令常用的置换表、静态死活识别和安全剪枝难以直接使用。论文提出并行深度优先证明数搜索器 Sanko，以廉价的证明转移定理恢复这些工具的可靠使用，并据此重新求解棋盘、报告新的棋盘价值；证明转移具体条件需以论文全文为准。

entries.cynic_review: 摘要未列棋盘实例数量和性能对比，不能由方法描述推断全面领先。
entries.paper_review: 证明转移机制直接针对 PSK 破坏传统搜索工具的核心障碍。

entries.source_title: A secondary term in the first moment of cubic $L$-functions over function fields
entries.source_excerpt: Let $q$ be a fixed odd prime power with $q\equiv2\pmod3$. We study the first moment of primitive cubic Dirichlet $L$-functions over $\Fq(T)$, ordered by their genus. By averaging the rational sieve variable in the double Dirichlet series of Hong and Fang, we obtain meromorphic continuation beyond the secondary polar divisor. Combining this continuation with the cubic Gauss-sum residues computed by David, Florea and Lal\'in gives an explicit term of order $q^{5g/6}$, with a real coefficient depending on $g$ modulo $6$, and an error $O_{q,\eps}(q^{(23/28+\eps)g})$. The periodic coefficient is not identically zero. The proof uses an exact first difference supplied by the functional equation, an Euler product for the sieve average, and Bochner's tube theorem in the Dirichlet variables.
entries.title_zh: 函数域上三次 L 函数一阶矩的次主项
entries.summary_zh: 固定奇素数幂 q≡2 mod 3，作者研究 F_q(T) 上按亏格排序的原始三次 Dirichlet L 函数一阶矩。通过平均化双 Dirichlet 级数中的有理筛变量并延拓越过次极点，得到量级 q^{5g/6} 的显式次主项，其系数随 g 模 6 周期变化且非恒零，误差为 O(q^{(23/28+ε)g})。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合解析数论、函数域 L 函数矩和筛法技术。
entries.pragmatic_review: L 函数矩反映一族对象整体的平均算术行为。
entries.cynic_review: 给出次主项量级、周期性和误差阶。
entries.paper_review: 结论对 q 的合同条件有要求，证明技术性高。

entries.source_title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
entries.source_excerpt: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. entries.source_title: There can be equitable social welfare orders but no fair voting system
entries.source_excerpt: In the context of intergenerational equity it is natural to ask that social welfare orders have th properties of finite anonymity and strong Pareto efficiency. Such social welfare orders can be constructed from nonprincipal ultrafilters over the set of natural numbers, and the existence of ultrafilters of this kind is known to be equivalent to the existence of a fair voting system for a countably infinite population in the sense of Arrow's theorem. Unfortunately, the existence of this variety of social welfare order, which we call anonymous Pareto, implies the existence of nonmeasurable sets of real numbers. For some, such as Litak, this entails that such social welfare orders are inadmissible for use in theoretical economics because they are non-constructive in nature. The authors seek to give nuance to this view, proving that anonymous Pareto and other social welfare orders can exist in the absence of nonprincipal ultrafilters over the set of natural numbers.

entries.source_title: Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability
entries.source_excerpt: LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains. We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains. We further show that selective graph grounding improves correctness and cross-model consistency, while indiscriminate grounding introduces regressions. A layered grounding strategy achieves the strongest monotonicity profile, preserving correct knowledge while reducing inconsistency. F

entries.source_title: Characteristic Chow Polynomials of Layered-Permutation Intervals
entries.source_excerpt: We study characteristic Chow polynomials of principal intervals in generalized subword order, equivalently of pattern-containment intervals below layered permutations. A terminal-chain recurrence and canonical rightmost embeddings yield a recursive rational generating function for every fixed number of layers, governed by a universal denominator. In the two-layer case we obtain an explicit kernel, prove canonical interlacing when one layer has size at most four, and prove eventual interlacing at every fixed width by a Laguerre limit. We also treat two families with unboundedly many layers. Singleton-prefix intervals have a closed Delannoy-Jacobi gamma polynomial and form real-rooted interlacing sequences. Singleton-sandwich intervals admit rational three-variable series and a marked-slot formula for all gamma coefficients. Their central-layer-two and central-layer-three slices are real-rooted, with interlacing under growth from two to three. entries.source_title: Asymptotic dimension of graphs excluding an induced or fat minor
entries.source_excerpt: Asymptotic dimension is a large-scale invariant of metric spaces that was introduced by Gromov (1993). A major open problem in coarse graph theory asks whether, for every fixed graph $H$, the class of graphs excluding $H$ as a fat minor has bounded asymptotic dimension. A weaker conjecture asserts the same conclusion for graphs excluding $H$ as an induced minor. We substantially expand the range of graphs $H$ for which these conjectures are known to hold. Specifically, we prove bounded asymptotic dimension for the following classes of graphs: graphs excluding a fixed planar graph as a fat minor; and graphs excluding a fixed string graph as an induced minor. All of our results also hold for the stronger notion of Assouad--Nagata dimension, a refinement of asymptotic dimension. These results have a number of applications, two of which we mention here. First they imply that an induced minor-closed class is $\chi$-bounded if and only if it does not contain some Burling graph. Second they imply that, in graph classes excluding a fixed planar graph as an induced minor, treewidth is polynomial in maximum degree.

entries.source_title: Sages and Their Anonymous Slips
entries.source_excerpt: Before the game, the sages agree on a finite set of symbols and on a rule for choosing one of them. They are then seated in an unknown order, either in a row or around a circle with a common clockwise direction. Each sage sees only the adjacent sage or sages and secretly writes one symbol. The slips are then mixed, so nobody learns who wrote which symbol; everyone learns only how many times each symbol occurred. The aim is that every sage should be able to independently reconstruct the entire seating. We ask for the smallest number of distinct symbols that makes this possible. We also consider a version in which the seats have fixed public labels, and each sage is told the label of their own seat. For large numbers of sages, the minimum number of symbols is proportional to the square of the number of sages, up to a constant factor. Several small cases can be settled exactly. Four sages in a row need exactly two symbols, and so do five sages on a circle. Six sages on a circle need exactly three symbols, both with and without labeled seats; we give a short explicit rule. entries.title_zh: 智者与匿名纸条：最少需要多少种符号？
entries.summary_zh: 多人按未知顺序坐成一排或圆圈，每人只看相邻者并写一个有限符号；纸条混合后所有人只知道各符号出现次数，目标是每个人都能还原完整座次。论文证明人数较大时最少符号数与人数平方同阶，并精确求出若干小例（如四人一排需两种符号、五人圆圈需两种、六人圆圈需三种）。

entries.paper_review: 大人数常数和更广标签情形需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.
entries.title_zh: Guided-RLVR：为可验证奖励强化学习引导探索
entries.summary_zh: 作者认为 RLVR 训练容易收缩到少数推理轨迹，提出轻量控制器在采样中注入有语义的引导 token，让模型从多种角度探索数学题和代码任务。论文报告其在相关基准上优于已有 RLVR 方法且轨迹更多样，但摘要没有列具体模型、增益幅度和成本。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注推理模型后训练的探索多样性与策略控制。
entries.pragmatic_review: RLVR 用答案可验证的任务奖励训练模型，而非仅靠偏好标签。
entries.cynic_review: 针对轨迹塌缩提出直接的采样侧干预。
entries.paper_review: 性能与多样性结论缺少此摘录中的具体数值。

entries.source_title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.
entries.title_zh: 通过激活空间引导探索可验证奖励强化学习
entries.summary_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习只从当前策略采样到的轨迹获得直接信号，有限预算下可能反复走相似推理路径。Activation-Space Exploration 对同题正确与错误回答的激活差异聚类，形成潜在探索向量库，再将不同向量施加到训练轨迹以多样化探索；这是一种在线表示空间引导方法，具体收益依赖向量构造和干预稳定性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 从正确与错误轨迹的内部激活差异中构造结构化探索方向。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合有自动验证奖励、但采样容易陷入重复路径的推理训练。
entries.cynic_review: 激活干预可能改变分布或产生副作用，需看消融与稳定性指标。
entries.paper_review: 针对 rollout 多样性不足提出可操作的在线探索机制。

entries.source_title: Scaling Qualitative Analysis with Large Language Models: Development and Validation of the Smart Coder Framework for Human-LLM Collaborative Coding
entries.source_excerpt: Current uses of large language models (LLMs) for qualitative coding often rely on ad hoc prompting with limited guidance for reliability and human oversight. To address these limitations, we propose the Smart Coder Framework, a three-phase approach structuring human-LLM collaborative coding through Instruction, Prompt Strategy, and Reliability Check. We evaluated the framework using 72 middle-school mathematics teacher interview transcripts and a human-consensus benchmark. A factorial design compared instructed versus uninstructed prompts, few-shot versus few-shot plus chain-of-thought prompting, and single-pass versus self-consistency coding. Twelve transcripts were used for prompt development and calibration, and 60 for the formal evaluation. In the results, instruction consistently improved agreement. Chain-of-thought further improved agreement under adequate instruction, and self-consistency produced smaller, theme-dependent gains but helped identify unstable decisions for human review. Performance also varied by transcript characteristics. Overall, the framework systematically structures and monitors LLM-assisted qualitative codi
entries.title_zh: Smart Coder：可审查的人机协作定性编码框架
entries.summary_zh: Smart Coder 把访谈主题编码分成指令、提示策略和可靠性检查三阶段，并在 72 份中学数学教师访谈上与人工共识基准比较。充分指令稳定提高一致性；思维链在指导足够时继续改善一致性，自一致性带来的提升较小且依主题而异，但能标记不稳定决策供人复核。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合教育与社会科学团队把 LLM 纳入定性研究分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 定性编码把文本片段标注到研究主题，审核流程是可靠性关键。
entries.cynic_review: 有校准/正式评估分离和多种提示因素对照。
entries.paper_review: 结果取决于访谈主题与人工共识质量，不能消除研究者判断。

entries.source_title: Causal Edit Serialization
entries.source_excerpt: Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. Across model scales and editing baselines, CES models demonstrate complete applied edits with modestly higher clean-text bits per byte than clean autoregressive models. Supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training provide a grammatical-error-correction proof of concept, producing more beneficial than harmful changes under reference
entries.title_zh: 因果编辑序列化
entries.summary_zh: CES 用专门指针 token 与源位置地址，把插入、删除、替换、复制和移动表示为自回归序列中的显式编辑操作。模型保留因果注意力，加入定位头和双索引 RoPE，并以随机损坏、模型生成修改及重复文本构造修复预训练数据；实验报告可执行编辑完整度提升但干净文本 bits-per-byte 略高，语法纠错微调提供概念验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合文本编辑模型和自回归解码研究者了解显式编辑动作表示。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把回看和局部修改纳入因果生成形式，编辑操作具有可定位性。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要显示语言建模代价略增，复杂编辑任务收益范围待评估。
entries.paper_review: 结构与训练方案清楚，质量—效率权衡和基线细节需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Nef complexity of klt Fano varieties: the full spectrum and classification below two
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X$ be a complex klt Fano variety. We study the rational total index $\tau_X$ and the nef complexity $c_X=\dim X+\rho(X)-\tau_X$. Previous joint work of the author with Enwright, Filipazzi, Gongyo, Moraga, Svaldi, and Wang established the corresponding nonnegativity and zero-case characterization in the broader framework of a special class of generalized log Calabi--Yau pairs. Here we give a direct proof in the Fano setting, prove that there is no value strictly between zero and one, and classify all klt Fano varieties with $c_X<2$, without assuming $\mathbb Q$-factoriality. At complexity one, after splitting off projective-space factors, the remaining factor is a normal quadric of Picard number one, a linear blow-up of projective space, or an integral $(1,1)$ hypersurface in a product of projective spaces. If $1<2$, only two weighted-projective families occur; in particular, no smooth Fano variety has nef complexity strictly between one and two. We also determine the spectrum when the dimension is allowed to vary: \[ \{0\}\cup\left\{2-\frac2q \ \middle| \ q\in\mathbb Z_{\geq2}\right\} \cup(\mathbb Q\cap[2,\infty)). \] Most proofs
entries.title_zh: klt Fano 簇的 nef 复杂度全谱及小于二的分类
entries.summary_zh: 论文对复数域上的 klt Fano 簇研究有理总指标 τ_X 与 nef 复杂度 c_X=dim X+ρ(X)−τ_X。作者在 Fano 情形直接证明非负性、排除 0 与 1 之间的取值，并在不假设 Q-因子阶条件下完整分类 c_X<2 的对象；复杂度 1 时剥离射影空间因子后，剩余因子须属于摘要列出的低 Picard 数特殊类别。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出 nef 复杂度从非负性到小复杂度对象分类的完整结构结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 主要面向双有理几何与 Fano 分类研究。
entries.cynic_review: 分类只覆盖复杂度严格小于二，结论依赖 klt Fano 条件。
entries.paper_review: 填补复杂度值谱并在不要求 Q-因子阶时完成分类。

entries.source_title: Computable presentations of separable Lebesgue spaces
entries.source_excerpt: For every right-c.e.\ real $p\in(1,2)$, $L^p[0,1]$ has a computable presentation. The proof combines an effective stability modulus for almost isometric embeddings with a Fra\"{\i}ss\'e-style construction in which the exponent varies. In the same range, if $\ell^p$ has a computable presentation, then $p$ is computable. Combining these with the known results gives the computable presentability classification for all separable Lebesgue spaces. We also formulate an effective Fra\"{\i}ss\'e theorem for Banach spaces and apply it to obtain a computable presentation of the Gurarij Banach space.
entries.title_zh: 可分 Lebesgue 空间的可计算表示分类
entries.summary_zh: 论文声称对一到二之间每个右可枚举实数 p，Lᵖ[0,1] 都有可计算表示，而同区间内 ℓᵖ 可计算可表示会迫使 p 可计算。作者结合近等距嵌入的有效稳定模与变指数 Fraïssé 构造，并给出 Gurarij 空间的可计算表示。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合可计算分析与 Banach 空间模型论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 明确连续与离散 Lᵖ 空间的可计算差异。
entries.cynic_review: 表示可计算不等于指数本身可计算。
entries.paper_review: 有效构造与完整分类互相支撑。
